translations.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
translations.ylt: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God;
translations.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

translations.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.
translations.ylt: this one was in the beginning with God;
translations.web: The same was in the beginning with God.

translations.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
translations.ylt: all things through him did happen, and without him happened not even one thing that hath happened.
translations.web: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

translations.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
translations.ylt: In him was life, and the life was the light of men,
translations.web: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

translations.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
translations.ylt: and the light in the darkness did shine, and the darkness did not perceive it.
translations.web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

translations.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
translations.ylt: There came a man--having been sent from God--whose name is John,
translations.web: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

translations.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
translations.ylt: this one came for testimony, that he might testify about the Light, that all might believe through him;
translations.web: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

translations.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
translations.ylt: that one was not the Light, but--that he might testify about the Light.
translations.web: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

translations.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
translations.ylt: He was the true Light, which doth enlighten every man, coming to the world;
translations.web: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

translations.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
translations.ylt: in the world he was, and the world through him was made, and the world did not know him:
translations.web: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

translations.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
translations.ylt: to his own things he came, and his own people did not receive him;
translations.web: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

translations.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
translations.ylt: but as many as did receive him to them he gave authority to become sons of God--to those believing in his name,
translations.web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

translations.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
translations.ylt: who--not of blood nor of a will of flesh, nor of a will of man but--of God were begotten.
translations.web: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

translations.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
translations.ylt: And the Word became flesh, and did tabernacle among us, and we beheld his glory, glory as of an only begotten of a father, full of grace and truth.
translations.web: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

translations.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
translations.ylt: John doth testify concerning him, and hath cried, saying, `This was he of whom I said, He who after me is coming, hath come before me, for he was before me;'
translations.web: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

translations.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
translations.ylt: and out of his fulness did we all receive, and grace over-against grace;
translations.web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

translations.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: for the law through Moses was given, the grace and the truth through Jesus Christ did come;
translations.web: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
translations.ylt: God no one hath ever seen; the only begotten Son, who is on the bosom of the Father--he did declare.
translations.web: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

translations.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
translations.ylt: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent out of Jerusalem priests and Levites, that they might question him, `Who art thou?'
translations.web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

translations.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
translations.ylt: and he confessed and did not deny, and confessed--`I am not the Christ.'
translations.web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

translations.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
translations.ylt: And they questioned him, `What then? Elijah art thou?' and he saith, `I am not.' --`The prophet art thou?' and he answered, `No.'
translations.web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
translations.ylt: They said then to him, `Who art thou, that we may give an answer to those sending us? what dost thou say concerning thyself?'
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

translations.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
translations.ylt: He said, `I am a voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.'
translations.web: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

translations.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
translations.ylt: And those sent were of the Pharisees,
translations.web: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

translations.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
translations.ylt: and they questioned him and said to him, `Why, then, dost thou baptize, if thou art not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?'
translations.web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

translations.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
translations.ylt: John answered them, saying, `I baptize with water, but in midst of you he hath stood whom ye have not known, this one it is who is coming after me, who hath been before me,
translations.web: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

translations.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
translations.ylt: of whom I am not worthy that I may loose the cord of his sandal.'
translations.web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

translations.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
translations.ylt: These things came to pass in Bethabara, beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing,
translations.web: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

translations.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
translations.ylt: on the morrow John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, `Lo, the Lamb of God, who is taking away the sin of the world;
translations.web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

translations.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
translations.ylt: this is he concerning whom I said, After me doth come a man, who hath come before me, because he was before me:
translations.web: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

translations.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
translations.ylt: and I knew him not, but, that he might be manifested to Israel, because of this I came with the water baptizing.
translations.web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

translations.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
translations.ylt: And John testified, saying--`I have seen the Spirit coming down, as a dove, out of heaven, and it remained on him;
translations.web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

translations.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and I did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, He said to me, On whomsoever thou mayest see the Spirit coming down, and remaining on him, this is he who is baptizing with the Holy Spirit;
translations.web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

translations.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and I have seen, and have testified, that this is the Son of God.'
translations.web: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

translations.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
translations.ylt: On the morrow, again, John was standing, and two of his disciples,
translations.web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

translations.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
translations.ylt: and having looked on Jesus walking, he saith, `Lo, the Lamb of God;'
translations.web: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

translations.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
translations.ylt: and the two disciples heard him speaking, and they followed Jesus.
translations.web: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
translations.ylt: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, `What seek ye?' and they said to them, `Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'
translations.web: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

translations.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
translations.ylt: He saith to them, `Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.
translations.web: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

translations.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
translations.ylt: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who heard from John, and followed him;
translations.web: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

translations.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
translations.ylt: this one doth first find his own brother Simon, and saith to him, `We have found the Messiah,' (which is, being interpreted, The Anointed,)
translations.web: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

translations.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
translations.ylt: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, `Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)
translations.web: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

translations.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
translations.ylt: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, `Be following me.'
translations.web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

translations.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
translations.ylt: And Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter;
translations.web: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

translations.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
translations.ylt: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith to him, `Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets, we have found, Jesus the son of Joseph, who is from Nazareth;'
translations.web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

translations.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
translations.ylt: and Nathanael said to him, `Out of Nazareth is any good thing able to be?' Philip said to him, `Come and see.'
translations.web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
translations.ylt: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, `Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'
translations.web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

translations.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
translations.ylt: Nathanael saith to him, `Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, `Before Philip's calling thee--thou being under the fig-tree--I saw thee.'
translations.web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

translations.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
translations.ylt: Nathanael answered and saith to him, `Rabbi, thou art the Son of God, thou art the king of Israel.'
translations.web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to him, `Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

translations.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
translations.ylt: and he saith to him, `Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'
translations.web: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

translations.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
translations.ylt: And the third day a marriage happened in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there,
translations.web: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

translations.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
translations.ylt: and also Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage;
translations.web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

translations.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
translations.ylt: and wine having failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, `Wine they have not;'
translations.web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `What--to me and to thee, woman? not yet is mine hour come.'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

translations.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
translations.ylt: His mother saith to the ministrants, `Whatever he may say to you--do.'
translations.web: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

translations.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
translations.ylt: And there were there six water-jugs of stone, placed according to the purifying of the Jews, holding each two or three measures.
translations.web: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to them, `Fill the water-jugs with water;' and they filled them--unto the brim;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `Draw out, now, and bear to the director of the apartment;' and they bare.
translations.web: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

translations.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
translations.ylt: And as the director of the apartment tasted the water become wine, and knew not whence it is, (but the ministrants knew, who have drawn the water,) the director of the feast doth call the bridegroom,
translations.web: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

translations.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
translations.ylt: and saith to him, `Every man, at first, the good wine doth set forth; and when they may have drunk freely, then the inferior; thou didst keep the good wine till now.'
translations.web: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

translations.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
translations.ylt: This beginning of the signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory, and his disciples believed in him;
translations.web: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

translations.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
translations.ylt: after this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples; and there they remained not many days.
translations.web: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

translations.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
translations.ylt: And the passover of the Jews was nigh, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
translations.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
translations.ylt: and he found in the temple those selling oxen, and sheep, and doves, and the money-changers sitting,
translations.web: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

translations.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
translations.ylt: and having made a whip of small cords, he put all forth out of the temple, also the sheep, and the oxen; and of the money-changers he poured out the coins, and the tables he overthrew,
translations.web: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

translations.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
translations.ylt: and to those selling the doves he said, `Take these things hence; make not the house of my Father a house of merchandise.'
translations.web: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

translations.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
translations.ylt: And his disciples remembered that it is written, `The zeal of Thy house did eat me up;'
translations.web: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

translations.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
translations.ylt: the Jews then answered and said to him, `What sign dost thou shew to us--that thou dost these things?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to them, `Destroy this sanctuary, and in three days I will raise it up.'
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said, `Forty and six years was this sanctuary building, and wilt thou in three days raise it up?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

translations.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.
translations.ylt: but he spake concerning the sanctuary of his body;
translations.web: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

translations.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
translations.ylt: when, then, he was raised out of the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this to them, and they believed the Writing, and the word that Jesus said.
translations.web: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

translations.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
translations.ylt: And as he was in Jerusalem, in the passover, in the feast, many believed in his name, beholding his signs that he was doing;
translations.web: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

translations.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
translations.ylt: and Jesus himself was not trusting himself to them, because of his knowing all men,
translations.web: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

translations.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
translations.ylt: and because he had no need that any should testify concerning man, for he himself was knowing what was in man.
translations.web: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

translations.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
translations.ylt: And there was a man of the Pharisees, Nicodemus his name, a ruler of the Jews,
translations.web: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

translations.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
translations.ylt: this one came unto him by night, and said to him, `Rabbi, we have known that from God thou hast come--a teacher, for no one these signs is able to do that thou dost, if God may not be with him.'
translations.web: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to him, `Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born from above, he is not able to see the reign of God;'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
translations.ylt: Nicodemus saith unto him, `How is a man able to be born, being old? is he able into the womb of his mother a second time to enter, and to be born?'
translations.web: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born of water, and the Spirit, he is not able to enter into the reign of God;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

translations.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
translations.ylt: that which hath been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which hath been born of the Spirit is spirit.
translations.web: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

translations.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
translations.ylt: `Thou mayest not wonder that I said to thee, It behoveth you to be born from above;
translations.web: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

translations.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
translations.ylt: the Spirit where he willeth doth blow, and his voice thou dost hear, but thou hast not known whence he cometh, and whither he goeth; thus is every one who hath been born of the Spirit.'
translations.web: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

translations.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
translations.ylt: Nicodemus answered and said to him, `How are these things able to happen?'
translations.web: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to him, `Thou art the teacher of Israel--and these things thou dost not know!
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to thee--What we have known we speak, and what we have seen we testify, and our testimony ye do not receive;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

translations.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
translations.ylt: if the earthly things I said to you, and ye do not believe, how, if I shall say to you the heavenly things, will ye believe?
translations.web: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

translations.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
translations.ylt: and no one hath gone up to the heaven, except he who out of the heaven came down--the Son of Man who is in the heaven.
translations.web: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

translations.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
translations.ylt: `And as Moses did lift up the serpent in the wilderness, so it behoveth the Son of Man to be lifted up,
translations.web: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

translations.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
translations.ylt: that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during,
translations.web: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

translations.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
translations.ylt: for God did so love the world, that His Son--the only begotten--He gave, that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during.
translations.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

translations.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
translations.ylt: For God did not send His Son to the world that he may judge the world, but that the world may be saved through him;
translations.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

translations.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
translations.ylt: he who is believing in him is not judged, but he who is not believing hath been judged already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
translations.web: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

translations.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
translations.ylt: `And this is the judgment, that the light hath come to the world, and men did love the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil;
translations.web: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

translations.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
translations.ylt: for every one who is doing wicked things hateth the light, and doth not come unto the light, that his works may not be detected;
translations.web: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

translations.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
translations.ylt: but he who is doing the truth doth come to the light, that his works may be manifested, that in God they are having been wrought.'
translations.web: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

translations.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
translations.ylt: After these things came Jesus and his disciples to the land of Judea, and there he did tarry with them, and was baptizing;
translations.web: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

translations.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
translations.ylt: and John was also baptizing in Aenon, nigh to Salem, because there were many waters there, and they were coming and were being baptized--
translations.web: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

translations.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.
translations.ylt: for John was not yet cast into the prison--
translations.web: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

translations.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.
translations.ylt: there arose then a question from the disciples of John with some Jews about purifying,
translations.web: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

translations.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
translations.ylt: and they came unto John, and said to him, `Rabbi, he who was with thee beyond the Jordan, to whom thou didst testify, lo, this one is baptizing, and all are coming unto him.'
translations.web: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

translations.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
translations.ylt: John answered and said, `A man is not able to receive anything, if it may not have been given him from the heaven;
translations.web: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

translations.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
translations.ylt: ye yourselves do testify to me that I said, I am not the Christ, but, that I am having been sent before him;
translations.web: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

translations.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
translations.ylt: he who is having the bride is bridegroom, and the friend of the bridegroom, who is standing and hearing him, with joy doth rejoice because of the voice of the bridegroom; this, then, my joy hath been fulfilled.
translations.web: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

translations.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
translations.ylt: `Him it behoveth to increase, and me to become less;
translations.web: He must increase, but I must decrease.

translations.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
translations.ylt: he who from above is coming is above all; he who is from the earth, from the earth he is, and from the earth he speaketh; he who from the heaven is coming is above all.
translations.web: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

translations.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
translations.ylt: `And what he hath seen and heard this he doth testify, and his testimony none receiveth;
translations.web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

translations.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
translations.ylt: he who is receiving his testimony did seal that God is true;
translations.web: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

translations.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
translations.ylt: for he whom God sent, the sayings of God he speaketh; for not by measure doth God give the Spirit;
translations.web: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

translations.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
translations.ylt: the Father doth love the Son, and all things hath given into his hand;
translations.web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

translations.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
translations.ylt: he who is believing in the Son, hath life age-during; and he who is not believing the Son, shall not see life, but the wrath of God doth remain upon him.'
translations.web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

translations.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
translations.ylt: When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees heard that Jesus more disciples doth make and baptize than John,
translations.web: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

translations.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
translations.ylt: (though indeed Jesus himself was not baptizing, but his disciples,)
translations.web: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

translations.kjv: He left Judea, and departed again into Galilee.
translations.ylt: he left Judea and went away again to Galilee,
translations.web: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

translations.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
translations.ylt: and it was behoving him to go through Samaria.
translations.web: He needed to pass through Samaria.

translations.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
translations.ylt: He cometh, therefore, to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near to the place that Jacob gave to Joseph his son;
translations.web: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

translations.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
translations.ylt: and there was there a well of Jacob. Jesus therefore having been weary from the journeying, was sitting thus on the well; it was as it were the sixth hour;
translations.web: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

translations.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
translations.ylt: there cometh a woman out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus saith to her, `Give me to drink;'
translations.web: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

translations.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
translations.ylt: for his disciples were gone away to the city, that they may buy victuals;
translations.web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

translations.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
translations.ylt: the Samaritan woman therefore saith to him, `How dost thou, being a Jew, ask drink from me, being a Samaritan woman?' for Jews have no dealing with Samaritans.
translations.web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to her, `If thou hadst known the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to thee, Give me to drink, thou wouldest have asked him, and he would have given thee living water.'
translations.web: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
translations.ylt: The woman saith to him, `Sir, thou hast not even a vessel to draw with, and the well is deep; whence, then, hast thou the living water?
translations.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

translations.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
translations.ylt: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who did give us the well, and himself out of it did drink, and his sons, and his cattle?'
translations.web: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to her, `Every one who is drinking of this water shall thirst again;
translations.web: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

translations.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
translations.ylt: but whoever may drink of the water that I will give him, may not thirst--to the age; and the water that I will give him shall become in him a well of water, springing up to life age-during.'
translations.web: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
translations.ylt: The woman saith unto him, `Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come hither to draw.'
translations.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Go, call thy husband, and come hither;'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

translations.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
translations.ylt: the woman answered and said, `I have not a husband.' Jesus saith to her, `Well didst thou say--A husband I have not;
translations.web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

translations.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
translations.ylt: for five husbands thou hast had, and, now, he whom thou hast is not thy husband; this hast thou said truly.'
translations.web: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
translations.ylt: The woman saith to him, `Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet;
translations.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

translations.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
translations.ylt: our fathers in this mountain did worship, and ye--ye say that in Jerusalem is the place where it behoveth to worship.'
translations.web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Woman, believe me, that there doth come an hour, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father;
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

translations.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
translations.ylt: ye worship what ye have not known; we worship what we have known, because the salvation is of the Jews;
translations.web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

translations.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
translations.ylt: but, there cometh an hour, and it now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father also doth seek such to worship him;
translations.web: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

translations.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
translations.ylt: God is a Spirit, and those worshipping Him, in spirit and truth it doth behove to worship.'
translations.web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
translations.ylt: The woman saith to him, `I have known that Messiah doth come, who is called Christ, when that one may come, he will tell us all things;'
translations.web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `I am he, who am speaking to thee.'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

translations.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
translations.ylt: And upon this came his disciples, and were wondering that with a woman he was speaking, no one, however, said, `What seekest thou?' or `Why speakest thou with her?'
translations.web: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

translations.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
translations.ylt: The woman then left her water-jug, and went away to the city, and saith to the men,
translations.web: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

translations.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
translations.ylt: `Come, see a man, who told me all things--as many as I did; is this the Christ?'
translations.web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

translations.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
translations.ylt: They went forth therefore out of the city, and were coming unto him.
translations.web: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

translations.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
translations.ylt: And in the meanwhile his disciples were asking him, saying, `Rabbi, eat;'
translations.web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

translations.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `I have food to eat that ye have not known.'
translations.web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

translations.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
translations.ylt: The disciples then said one to another, `Did any one bring him anything to eat?'
translations.web: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to them, `My food is, that I may do the will of Him who sent me, and may finish His work;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

translations.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
translations.ylt: do not say that it is yet four months, and the harvest cometh; lo, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and see the fields, that they are white unto harvest already.
translations.web: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

translations.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
translations.ylt: `And he who is reaping doth receive a reward, and doth gather fruit to life age-during, that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping may rejoice together;
translations.web: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

translations.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
translations.ylt: for in this the saying is the true one, that one is the sower and another the reaper.
translations.web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

translations.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
translations.ylt: I sent you to reap that on which ye have not laboured; others laboured, and ye into their labour have entered.
translations.web: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

translations.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
translations.ylt: And from that city many believed in him, of the Samaritans, because of the word of the woman testifying, --`He told me all things--as many as I did.'
translations.web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

translations.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
translations.ylt: When, then, the Samaritans came unto him, they were asking him to remain with them, and he remained there two days;
translations.web: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

translations.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;
translations.ylt: and many more did believe because of his word,
translations.web: Many more believed because of his word.

translations.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
translations.ylt: and said to the woman--`No more because of thy speaking do we believe; for we ourselves have heard and known that this is truly the Saviour of the world--the Christ.'
translations.web: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

translations.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
translations.ylt: And after the two days he went forth thence, and went away to Galilee,
translations.web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

translations.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
translations.ylt: for Jesus himself testified that a prophet in his own country shall not have honour;
translations.web: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

translations.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
translations.ylt: when then, he came to Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all things that he did in Jerusalem in the feast--for they also went to the feast.
translations.web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

translations.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
translations.ylt: Jesus came, therefore, again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine, and there was a certain courtier, whose son was ailing in Capernaum,
translations.web: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

translations.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
translations.ylt: he, having heard that Jesus is come out of Judea to Galilee, went away unto him, and was asking him that he may come down and may heal his son, for he was about to die.
translations.web: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
translations.ylt: Jesus then said unto him, `If signs and wonders ye may not see, ye will not believe.'
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

translations.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
translations.ylt: The courtier saith unto him, `Sir, come down before my child die;'
translations.web: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `Be going on; thy son doth live.' And the man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and was going on,
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

translations.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
translations.ylt: and he now going down, his servants met him, and told, saying--`Thy child doth live;'
translations.web: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

translations.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
translations.ylt: he inquired then of them the hour in which he became better, and they said to him--`Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him;'
translations.web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

translations.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
translations.ylt: then the father knew that it was in that hour in which Jesus said to him--`Thy son doth live,' and he himself believed, and his whole house;
translations.web: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

translations.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judea into Galilee.
translations.ylt: this again a second sign did Jesus, having come out of Judea to Galilee.
translations.web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

translations.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
translations.web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
translations.ylt: and there is in Jerusalem by the sheep- gate a pool that is called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches,
translations.web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

translations.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
translations.ylt: in these were lying a great multitude of the ailing, blind, lame, withered, waiting for the moving of the water,
translations.web: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

translations.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
translations.ylt: and there was a certain man there being in ailment thirty and eight years,
translations.web: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

translations.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
translations.ylt: him Jesus having seen lying, and having known that he is already a long time, he saith to him, `Dost thou wish to become whole?'
translations.web: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

translations.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
translations.ylt: The ailing man answered him, `Sir, I have no man, that, when the water may be troubled, he may put me into the pool, and while I am coming, another doth go down before me.'
translations.web: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `Rise, take up thy couch, and be walking;'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

translations.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
translations.ylt: and immediately the man became whole, and he took up his couch, and was walking, and it was a sabbath on that day,
translations.web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

translations.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
translations.ylt: the Jews then said to him that hath been healed, `It is a sabbath; it is not lawful to thee to take up the couch.'
translations.web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

translations.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
translations.ylt: He answered them, `He who made me whole--that one said to me, Take up thy couch, and be walking;'
translations.web: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

translations.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
translations.ylt: they questioned him, then, `Who is the man who is saying to thee, Take up thy couch and be walking?'
translations.web: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

translations.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
translations.ylt: But he that was healed had not known who he is, for Jesus did move away, a multitude being in the place.
translations.web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

translations.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
translations.ylt: After these things, Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said to him, `Lo, thou hast become whole; sin no more, lest something worse may happen to thee.'
translations.web: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

translations.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
translations.ylt: The man went away, and told the Jews that it is Jesus who made him whole,
translations.web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

translations.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
translations.ylt: and because of this were the Jews persecuting Jesus, and seeking to kill him, because these things he was doing on a sabbath.
translations.web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

translations.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answered them, `My Father till now doth work, and I work;'
translations.web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

translations.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
translations.ylt: because of this, then, were the Jews seeking the more to kill him, because not only was he breaking the sabbath, but he also called God his own Father, making himself equal to God.
translations.web: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

translations.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
translations.ylt: Jesus therefore responded and said to them, `Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything of himself, if he may not see the Father doing anything; for whatever things He may do, these also the Son in like manner doth;
translations.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

translations.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
translations.ylt: for the Father doth love the Son, and doth shew to him all things that He himself doth; and greater works than these He will shew him, that ye may wonder.
translations.web: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

translations.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
translations.ylt: `For, as the Father doth raise the dead, and doth make alive, so also the Son doth make alive whom he willeth;
translations.web: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

translations.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
translations.ylt: for neither doth the Father judge any one, but all the judgment He hath given to the Son,
translations.web: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

translations.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
translations.ylt: that all may honour the Son according as they honour the Father; he who is not honouring the Son, doth not honour the Father who sent him.
translations.web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to you--He who is hearing my word, and is believing Him who sent me, hath life age-during, and to judgment he doth not come, but hath passed out of the death to the life.
translations.web: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to you--There cometh an hour, and it now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and those having heard shall live;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

translations.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
translations.ylt: for, as the Father hath life in himself, so He gave also to the Son to have life in himself,
translations.web: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

translations.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
translations.ylt: and authority He gave him also to do judgment, because he is Son of Man.
translations.web: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

translations.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
translations.ylt: `Wonder not at this, because there doth come an hour in which all those in the tombs shall hear his voice,
translations.web: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

translations.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
translations.ylt: and they shall come forth; those who did the good things to a rising again of life, and those who practised the evil things to a rising again of judgment.
translations.web: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

translations.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
translations.ylt: `I am not able of myself to do anything; according as I hear I judge, and my judgment is righteous, because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father who sent me.
translations.web: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

translations.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
translations.ylt: `If I testify concerning myself, my testimony is not true;
translations.web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

translations.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
translations.ylt: another there is who is testifying concerning me, and I have known that the testimony that he doth testify concerning me is true;
translations.web: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

translations.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
translations.ylt: ye have sent unto John, and he hath testified to the truth.
translations.web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

translations.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
translations.ylt: `But I do not receive testimony from man, but these things I say that ye may be saved;
translations.web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

translations.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
translations.ylt: he was the burning and shining lamp, and ye did will to be glad, for an hour, in his light.
translations.web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

translations.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
translations.ylt: `But I have the testimony greater than John's, for the works that the Father gave me, that I might finish them, the works themselves that I do, they testify concerning me, that the Father hath sent me.
translations.web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

translations.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
translations.ylt: `And the Father who sent me Himself hath testified concerning me; ye have neither heard His voice at any time, nor His appearance have ye seen;
translations.web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

translations.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
translations.ylt: and His word ye have not remaining in you, because whom He sent, him ye do not believe.
translations.web: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

translations.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
translations.ylt: `Ye search the Writings, because ye think in them to have life age-during, and these are they that are testifying concerning me;
translations.web: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

translations.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
translations.ylt: and ye do not will to come unto me, that ye may have life;
translations.web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

translations.kjv: I receive not honour from men.
translations.ylt: glory from man I do not receive,
translations.web: I don’t receive glory from men.

translations.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
translations.ylt: but I have known you, that the love of God ye have not in yourselves.
translations.web: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

translations.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
translations.ylt: `I have come in the name of my Father, and ye do not receive me; if another may come in his own name, him ye will receive;
translations.web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

translations.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
translations.ylt: how are ye able--ye--to believe, glory from one another receiving, and the glory that is from God alone ye seek not?
translations.web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

translations.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
translations.ylt: `Do not think that I will accuse you unto the Father; there is who is accusing you, Moses--in whom ye have hoped;
translations.web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

translations.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
translations.ylt: for if ye were believing Moses, ye would have been believing me, for he wrote concerning me;
translations.web: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

translations.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
translations.ylt: but if his writings ye believe not, how shall ye believe my sayings?'
translations.web: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
