translations.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
translations.ylt: After these things Jesus went away beyond the sea of Galilee (of Tiberias),
translations.web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

translations.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
translations.ylt: and there was following him a great multitude, because they were seeing his signs that he was doing on the ailing;
translations.web: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

translations.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
translations.ylt: and Jesus went up to the mount, and he was there sitting with his disciples,
translations.web: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

translations.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
translations.ylt: and the passover was nigh, the feast of the Jews.
translations.web: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

translations.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
translations.ylt: Jesus then having lifted up his eyes and having seen that a great multitude doth come to him, saith unto Philip, `Whence shall we buy loaves, that these may eat?' --
translations.web: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

translations.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
translations.ylt: and this he said, trying him, for he himself had known what he was about to do.
translations.web: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

translations.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
translations.ylt: Philip answered him, `Two hundred denaries' worth of loaves are not sufficient to them, that each of them may receive some little;'
translations.web: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

translations.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
translations.ylt: one of his disciples--Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter--saith to him,
translations.web: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

translations.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
translations.ylt: `There is one little lad here who hath five barley loaves, and two fishes, but these--what are they to so many?'
translations.web: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Make the men to sit down;' and there was much grass in the place, the men then sat down, in number, as it were, five thousand,
translations.web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

translations.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
translations.ylt: and Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those reclining, in like manner, also of the little fishes as much as they wished.
translations.web: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

translations.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
translations.ylt: And when they were filled, he saith to his disciples, `Gather together the broken pieces that are over, that nothing may be lost;'
translations.web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

translations.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
translations.ylt: they gathered together, therefore, and filled twelve hand-baskets with broken pieces, from the five barley loaves that were over to those having eaten.
translations.web: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

translations.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
translations.ylt: The men, then, having seen the sign that Jesus did, said--`This is truly the Prophet, who is coming to the world;'
translations.web: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, having known that they are about to come, and to take him by force that they may make him king, retired again to the mountain himself alone.
translations.web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

translations.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
translations.ylt: And when evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
translations.web: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

translations.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
translations.ylt: and having entered into the boat, they were going over the sea to Capernaum, and darkness had already come, and Jesus had not come unto them,
translations.web: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

translations.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
translations.ylt: the sea also--a great wind blowing--was being raised,
translations.web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

translations.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
translations.ylt: having pushed onwards, therefore, about twenty-five or thirty furlongs, they behold Jesus walking on the sea, and coming nigh to the boat, and they were afraid;
translations.web: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

translations.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `I am he, be not afraid;'
translations.web: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

translations.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
translations.ylt: they were willing then to receive him into the boat, and immediately the boat came unto the land to which they were going.
translations.web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

translations.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
translations.ylt: On the morrow, the multitude that was standing on the other side of the sea, having seen that there was no other little boat there except one--that into which his disciples entered--and that Jesus went not in with his disciples into the little boat, but his disciples went away alone,
translations.web: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

translations.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
translations.ylt: (and other little boats came from Tiberias, nigh the place where they did eat the bread, the Lord having given thanks),
translations.web: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

translations.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
translations.ylt: when therefore the multitude saw that Jesus is not there, nor his disciples, they also themselves did enter into the boats, and came to Capernaum seeking Jesus;
translations.web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

translations.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
translations.ylt: and having found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, `Rabbi, when hast thou come hither?'
translations.web: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them and said, `Verily, verily, I say to you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were satisfied;
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

translations.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
translations.ylt: work not for the food that is perishing, but for the food that is remaining to life age-during, which the Son of Man will give to you, for him did the Father seal-- even God.'
translations.web: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
translations.ylt: They said therefore unto him, `What may we do that we may work the works of God?'
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to them, `This is the work of God, that ye may believe in him whom He did send.'
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

translations.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
translations.ylt: They said therefore to him, `What sign, then, dost thou, that we may see and may believe thee? what dost thou work?
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

translations.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
translations.ylt: our fathers the manna did eat in the wilderness, according as it is having been written, Bread out of the heaven He gave them to eat.'
translations.web: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them, `Verily, verily, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread out of the heaven; but my Father doth give you the true bread out of the heaven;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

translations.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
translations.ylt: for the bread of God is that which is coming down out of the heaven, and giving life to the world.'
translations.web: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
translations.ylt: They said, therefore, unto him, `Sir, always give us this bread.'
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them, `I am the bread of the life; he who is coming unto me may not hunger, and he who is believing in me may not thirst--at any time;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

translations.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
translations.ylt: but I said to you, that ye also have seen me, and ye believe not;
translations.web: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

translations.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
translations.ylt: all that the Father doth give to me will come unto me; and him who is coming unto me, I may in no wise cast without,
translations.web: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

translations.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
translations.ylt: because I have come down out of the heaven, not that I may do my will, but the will of Him who sent me.
translations.web: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

translations.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
translations.ylt: `And this is the will of the Father who sent me, that all that He hath given to me I may not lose of it, but may raise it up in the last day;
translations.web: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

translations.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
translations.ylt: and this is the will of Him who sent me, that every one who is beholding the Son, and is believing in him, may have life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day.'
translations.web: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

translations.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, were murmuring at him, because he said, `I am the bread that came down out of the heaven;'
translations.web: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

translations.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
translations.ylt: and they said, `Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have known? how then saith this one--Out of the heaven I have come down?'
translations.web: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

translations.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, therefore, and said to them, `Murmur not one with another;
translations.web: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

translations.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
translations.ylt: no one is able to come unto me, if the Father who sent me may not draw him, and I will raise him up in the last day;
translations.web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

translations.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
translations.ylt: it is having been written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God; every one therefore who heard from the Father, and learned, cometh to me;
translations.web: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

translations.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
translations.ylt: not that any one hath seen the Father, except he who is from God, he hath seen the Father.
translations.web: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is believing in me, hath life age-during;
translations.web: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

translations.kjv: I am that bread of life.
translations.ylt: I am the bread of the life;
translations.web: I am the bread of life.

translations.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
translations.ylt: your fathers did eat the manna in the wilderness, and they died;
translations.web: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

translations.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
translations.ylt: this is the bread that out of the heaven is coming down, that any one may eat of it, and not die.
translations.web: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

translations.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
translations.ylt: `I am the living bread that came down out of the heaven; if any one may eat of this bread he shall live--to the age; and the bread also that I will give is my flesh, that I will give for the life of the world.'
translations.web: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

translations.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, were striving with one another, saying, `How is this one able to give us his flesh to eat?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them, `Verily, verily, I say to you, If ye may not eat the flesh of the Son of Man, and may not drink his blood, ye have no life in yourselves;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

translations.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
translations.ylt: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, hath life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day;
translations.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

translations.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
translations.ylt: for my flesh truly is food, and my blood truly is drink;
translations.web: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

translations.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
translations.ylt: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, doth remain in me, and I in him.
translations.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

translations.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
translations.ylt: `According as the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, he also who is eating me, even that one shall live because of me;
translations.web: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

translations.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
translations.ylt: this is the bread that came down out of the heaven; not as your fathers did eat the manna, and died; he who is eating this bread shall live--to the age.'
translations.web: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

translations.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
translations.ylt: These things he said in a synagogue, teaching in Capernaum;
translations.web: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

translations.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
translations.ylt: many, therefore, of his disciples having heard, said, `This word is hard; who is able to hear it?'
translations.web: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

translations.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
translations.ylt: And Jesus having known in himself that his disciples are murmuring about this, said to them, `Doth this stumble you?
translations.web: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

translations.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
translations.ylt: if then ye may behold the Son of Man going up where he was before?
translations.web: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

translations.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
translations.ylt: the spirit it is that is giving life; the flesh doth not profit anything; the sayings that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life;
translations.web: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

translations.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
translations.ylt: but there are certain of you who do not believe;' for Jesus had known from the beginning who they are who are not believing, and who is he who will deliver him up,
translations.web: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

translations.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Because of this I have said to you--No one is able to come unto me, if it may not have been given him from my Father.'
translations.web: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

translations.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
translations.ylt: From this time many of his disciples went away backward, and were no more walking with him,
translations.web: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to the twelve, `Do ye also wish to go away?'
translations.web: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

translations.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter, therefore, answered him, `Sir, unto whom shall we go? thou hast sayings of life age-during;
translations.web: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

translations.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
translations.ylt: and we have believed, and we have known, that thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.'
translations.web: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `Did not I choose you--the twelve? and of you--one is a devil.
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

translations.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
translations.ylt: And he spake of Judas, Simon's son, Iscariot, for he was about to deliver him up, being one of the twelve.
translations.web: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

translations.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
translations.ylt: And Jesus was walking after these things in Galilee, for he did not wish to walk in Judea, because the Jews were seeking to kill him,
translations.web: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

translations.kjv: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.
translations.ylt: and the feast of the Jews was nigh--that of tabernacles--
translations.web: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

translations.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
translations.ylt: his brethren, therefore, said unto him, `Remove hence, and go away to Judea, that thy disciples also may behold thy works that thou dost;
translations.web: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

translations.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
translations.ylt: for no one in secret doth anything, and himself seeketh to be in public; if thou dost these things--manifest thyself to the world;'
translations.web: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

translations.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
translations.ylt: for not even were his brethren believing in him.
translations.web: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, saith to them, `My time is not yet present, but your time is always ready;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

translations.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
translations.ylt: the world is not able to hate you, but me it doth hate, because I testify concerning it that its works are evil.
translations.web: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

translations.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
translations.ylt: Ye--go ye up to this feast; I do not yet go up to this feast, because my time hath not yet been fulfilled;'
translations.web: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

translations.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
translations.ylt: and saying these things to them, he remained in Galilee.
translations.web: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

translations.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
translations.ylt: And when his brethren went up, then also he himself went up to the feast, not manifestly, but as in secret;
translations.web: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

translations.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
translations.ylt: the Jews, therefore, were seeking him, in the feast, and said, `Where is that one?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

translations.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
translations.ylt: and there was much murmuring about him among the multitudes, some indeed said--`He is good;' and others said, `No, but he leadeth astray the multitude;'
translations.web: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

translations.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
translations.ylt: no one, however, was speaking freely about him, through fear of the Jews.
translations.web: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

translations.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
translations.ylt: And it being now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up to the temple, and he was teaching,
translations.web: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

translations.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
translations.ylt: and the Jews were wondering, saying, `How hath this one known letters--not having learned?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them and said, `My teaching is not mine, but His who sent me;
translations.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

translations.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
translations.ylt: if any one may will to do His will, he shall know concerning the teaching, whether it is of God, or--I do speak from myself.
translations.web: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

translations.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
translations.ylt: `He who is speaking from himself his own glory doth seek, but he who is seeking the glory of him who sent him, this one is true, and unrighteousness is not in him;
translations.web: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

translations.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
translations.ylt: hath not Moses given you the law? and none of you doth the law; why me do ye seek to kill?'
translations.web: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

translations.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
translations.ylt: The multitude answered and said, `Thou hast a demon, who doth seek to kill thee?'
translations.web: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to them, `One work I did, and ye all wonder,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

translations.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
translations.ylt: because of this, Moses hath given you the circumcision--not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers--and on a sabbath ye circumcise a man;
translations.web: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

translations.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
translations.ylt: if a man doth receive circumcision on a sabbath that the law of Moses may not be broken, are ye wroth with me that I made a man all whole on a sabbath?
translations.web: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

translations.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
translations.ylt: judge not according to appearance, but the righteous judgment judge.'
translations.web: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

translations.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
translations.ylt: Certain, therefore, of the Jerusalemites said, `Is not this he whom they are seeking to kill?
translations.web: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

translations.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
translations.ylt: and, lo, he doth speak freely, and they say nothing to him; did the rulers at all know truly that this is truly the Christ?
translations.web: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

translations.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
translations.ylt: but this one--we have known whence he is; and the Christ, when he doth come, no one doth know whence he is.'
translations.web: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

translations.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
translations.ylt: Jesus cried, therefore, in the temple, teaching and saying, `Ye have both known me, and ye have known whence I am; and I have not come of myself, but He who sent me is true, whom ye have not known;
translations.web: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

translations.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
translations.ylt: and I have known Him, because I am from Him, and He did send me.'
translations.web: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

translations.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
translations.ylt: They were seeking, therefore, to seize him, and no one laid the hand on him, because his hour had not yet come,
translations.web: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

translations.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
translations.ylt: and many out of the multitude did believe in him, and said--`The Christ--when he may come--will he do more signs than these that this one did?'
translations.web: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

translations.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
translations.ylt: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers that they may take him;
translations.web: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them, `Yet a little time I am with you, and I go away unto Him who sent me;
translations.web: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

translations.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
translations.ylt: ye will seek me, and ye shall not find; and where I am, ye are not able to come.'
translations.web: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said among themselves, `Whither is this one about to go that we shall not find him? --to the dispersion of the Greeks is he about to go? and to teach the Greeks;
translations.web: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

translations.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
translations.ylt: what is this word that he said, Ye will seek me, and ye shall not find? and, Where I am, ye are not able to come?'
translations.web: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

translations.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
translations.ylt: And in the last, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, `If any one doth thirst, let him come unto me and drink;
translations.web: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

translations.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
translations.ylt: he who is believing in me, according as the Writing said, Rivers out of his belly shall flow of living water;'
translations.web: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

translations.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
translations.ylt: and this he said of the Spirit, which those believing in him were about to receive; for not yet was the Holy Spirit, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
translations.web: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

translations.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
translations.ylt: Many, therefore out of the multitude, having heard the word, said, `This is truly the Prophet;'
translations.web: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

translations.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
translations.ylt: others said, `This is the Christ;' and others said, `Why, out of Galilee doth the Christ come?
translations.web: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

translations.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
translations.ylt: Did not the Writing say, that out of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem--the village where David was--the Christ doth come?'
translations.web: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

translations.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.
translations.ylt: A division, therefore, arose among the multitude because of him.
translations.web: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

translations.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
translations.ylt: And certain of them were willing to seize him, but no one laid hands on him;
translations.web: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

translations.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
translations.ylt: the officers came, therefore, unto the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, `Wherefore did ye not bring him?'
translations.web: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

translations.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
translations.ylt: The officers answered, `Never so spake man--as this man.'
translations.web: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

translations.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
translations.ylt: The Pharisees, therefore, answered them, `Have ye also been led astray?
translations.web: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

translations.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
translations.ylt: did any one out of the rulers believe in him? or out of the Pharisees?
translations.web: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

translations.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
translations.ylt: but this multitude, that is not knowing the law, is accursed.'
translations.web: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

translations.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
translations.ylt: Nicodemus saith unto them--he who came by night unto him--being one of them,
translations.web: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

translations.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
translations.ylt: `Doth our law judge the man, if it may not hear from him first, and know what he doth?'
translations.web: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
translations.ylt: They answered and said to him, `Art thou also out of Galilee? search and see, that a prophet out of Galilee hath not risen;'
translations.web: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

translations.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
translations.ylt: Again, therefore, Jesus spake to them, saying, `I am the light of the world; he who is following me shall not walk in the darkness, but he shall have the light of the life.'
translations.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

translations.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
translations.ylt: The Pharisees, therefore, said to him, `Thou of thyself dost testify, thy testimony is not true;'
translations.web: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to them, `And if I testify of myself--my testimony is true, because I have known whence I came, and whither I go, and ye--ye have not known whence I come, or whither I go.
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

translations.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
translations.ylt: `Ye according to the flesh do judge; I do not judge any one,
translations.web: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

translations.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
translations.ylt: and even if I do judge my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who sent me;
translations.web: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

translations.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
translations.ylt: and also in your law it hath been written, that the testimony of two men are true;
translations.web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

translations.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
translations.ylt: I am one who is testifying of myself, and the Father who sent me doth testify of me.'
translations.web: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
translations.ylt: They said, therefore, to him, `Where is thy father?' Jesus answered, `Ye have neither known me nor my Father: if me ye had known, my Father also ye had known.'
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

translations.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
translations.ylt: These sayings spake Jesus in the treasury, teaching in the temple, and no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come;
translations.web: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
translations.ylt: therefore said Jesus again to them, `I go away, and ye will seek me, and in your sin ye shall die; whither I go away, ye are not able to come.'
translations.web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said, `Will he kill himself, because he saith, Whither I go away, ye are not able to come?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Ye are from beneath, I am from above; ye are of this world, I am not of this world;
translations.web: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

translations.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
translations.ylt: I said, therefore, to you, that ye shall die in your sins, for if ye may not believe that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.'
translations.web: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
translations.ylt: They said, therefore, to him, `Thou--who art thou?' and Jesus said to them, `Even what I did speak of to you at the beginning;
translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

translations.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
translations.ylt: many things I have to speak concerning you and to judge, but He who sent me is true, and I--what things I heard from Him--these I say to the world.'
translations.web: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

translations.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
translations.ylt: They knew not that of the Father he spake to them;
translations.web: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them, `When ye may lift up the Son of Man then ye will know that I am he; and of myself I do nothing, but according as my Father did teach me, these things I speak;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

translations.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
translations.ylt: and He who sent me is with me; the Father did not leave me alone, because I, the things pleasing to Him, do always.'
translations.web: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

translations.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
translations.ylt: As he is speaking these things, many believed in him;
translations.web: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said unto the Jews who believed in him, `If ye may remain in my word, truly my disciples ye are, and ye shall know the truth,
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

translations.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
translations.ylt: and the truth shall make you free.'
translations.web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

translations.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
translations.ylt: They answered him, `Seed of Abraham we are; and to no one have we been servants at any time; how dost thou say--Ye shall become free?'
translations.web: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `Verily, verily, I say to you--Every one who is committing sin, is a servant of the sin,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

translations.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
translations.ylt: and the servant doth not remain in the house--to the age, the son doth remain--to the age;
translations.web: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

translations.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
translations.ylt: if then the son may make you free, in reality ye shall be free.
translations.web: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

translations.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
translations.ylt: `I have known that ye are seed of Abraham, but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you;
translations.web: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

translations.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
translations.ylt: I--that which I have seen with my Father do speak, and ye, therefore, that which ye have seen with your father--ye do.'
translations.web: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
translations.ylt: They answered and said to him, `Our father is Abraham;' Jesus saith to them, `If children of Abraham ye were, the works of Abraham ye were doing;
translations.web: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

translations.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
translations.ylt: and now, ye seek to kill me--a man who hath spoken to you the truth I heard from God; this Abraham did not;
translations.web: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

translations.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
translations.ylt: ye do the works of your father.' They said, therefore, to him, `We of whoredom have not been born; one Father we have--God;'
translations.web: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
translations.ylt: Jesus then said to them, `If God were your father, ye were loving me, for I came forth from God, and am come; for neither have I come of myself, but He sent me;
translations.web: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

translations.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
translations.ylt: wherefore do ye not know my speech? because ye are not able to hear my word.
translations.web: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

translations.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
translations.ylt: `Ye are of a father--the devil, and the desires of your father ye will to do; he was a man-slayer from the beginning, and in the truth he hath not stood, because there is no truth in him; when one may speak the falsehood, of his own he speaketh, because he is a liar--also his father.
translations.web: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

translations.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
translations.ylt: `And because I say the truth, ye do not believe me.
translations.web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

translations.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
translations.ylt: Who of you doth convict me of sin? and if I speak truth, wherefore do ye not believe me?
translations.web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

translations.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
translations.ylt: he who is of God, the sayings of God he doth hear; because of this ye do not hear, because of God ye are not.'
translations.web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

translations.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, answered and said to him, `Do we not say well, that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?'
translations.web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `I have not a demon, but I honour my Father, and ye dishonour me;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

translations.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
translations.ylt: and I do not seek my own glory; there is who is seeking and is judging;
translations.web: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to you, If any one may keep my word, death he may not see--to the age.'
translations.web: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said to him, `Now we have known that thou hast a demon; Abraham did die, and the prophets, and thou dost say, If any one may keep my word, he shall not taste of death--to the age!
translations.web: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

translations.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
translations.ylt: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died; whom dost thou make thyself?'
translations.web: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing; it is my Father who is glorifying me, of whom ye say that He is your God;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

translations.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
translations.ylt: and ye have not known Him, and I have known Him, and if I say that I have not known Him, I shall be like you--speaking falsely; but I have known Him, and His word I keep;
translations.web: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

translations.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
translations.ylt: Abraham, your father, was glad that he might see my day; and he saw, and did rejoice.'
translations.web: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said unto him, `Thou art not yet fifty years old, and Abraham hast thou seen?'
translations.web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
translations.ylt: Jesus said to them, `Verily, verily, I say to you, Before Abraham's coming--I am;'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

translations.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
translations.ylt: they took up, therefore, stones that they may cast at him, but Jesus hid himself, and went forth out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
translations.web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

translations.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
translations.ylt: And passing by, he saw a man blind from birth,
translations.web: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

translations.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
translations.ylt: and his disciples asked him, saying, `Rabbi, who did sin, this one or his parents, that he should be born blind?'
translations.web: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `Neither did this one sin nor his parents, but that the works of God may be manifested in him;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

translations.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
translations.ylt: it behoveth me to be working the works of Him who sent me while it is day; night doth come, when no one is able to work: --
translations.web: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

translations.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
translations.ylt: when I am in the world, I am a light of the world.'
translations.web: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

translations.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
translations.ylt: These things saying, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and rubbed the clay on the eyes of the blind man, and said to him,
translations.web: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

translations.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
translations.ylt: `Go away, wash at the pool of Siloam,' which is, interpreted, Sent. He went away, therefore, and did wash, and came seeing;
translations.web: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

translations.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
translations.ylt: the neighbours, therefore, and those seeing him before, that he was blind, said, `Is not this he who is sitting and begging?'
translations.web: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

translations.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
translations.ylt: others said--`This is he;' and others--`He is like to him;' he himself said, --`I am he.'
translations.web: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

translations.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
translations.ylt: They said, therefore, to him, `How were thine eyes opened?'
translations.web: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

translations.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
translations.ylt: he answered and said, `A man called Jesus made clay, and rubbed my eyes, and said to me, Go away to the pool of Siloam, and wash; and having gone away and having washed, I received sight;'
translations.web: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
translations.ylt: they said, therefore, to him, `Where is that one?' he saith, `I have not known.'
translations.web: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

translations.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
translations.ylt: They bring him to the Pharisees who once was blind,
translations.web: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

translations.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
translations.ylt: and it was a sabbath when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
translations.web: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

translations.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
translations.ylt: Again, therefore, the Pharisees also were asking him how he received sight, and he said to them, `Clay he did put upon my eyes, and I did wash--and I see.'
translations.web: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

translations.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
translations.ylt: Of the Pharisees, therefore, certain said, `This man is not from God, because the sabbath he doth not keep;' others said, `How is a man--a sinful one--able to do such signs?' and there was a division among them.
translations.web: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

translations.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
translations.ylt: They said to the blind man again, `Thou--what dost thou say of him--that he opened thine eyes?'
translations.web: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

translations.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
translations.ylt: and he said--`He is a prophet.' The Jews, therefore, did not believe concerning him that he was blind and did receive sight, till that they called the parents of him who received sight,
translations.web: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

translations.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
translations.ylt: and they asked them, saying, `Is your son, of whom ye say that he was born blind? how then now doth he see?'
translations.web: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

translations.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
translations.ylt: His parents answered them and said, `We have known that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
translations.web: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

translations.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
translations.ylt: and how he now seeth, we have not known; or who opened his eyes, we have not known; himself is of age, ask him; he himself shall speak concerning himself.'
translations.web: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

translations.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
translations.ylt: These things said his parents, because they were afraid of the Jews, for already had the Jews agreed together, that if any one may confess him--Christ, he may be put out of the synagogue;
translations.web: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

translations.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
translations.ylt: because of this his parents said--`He is of age, ask him.'
translations.web: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

translations.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
translations.ylt: They called, therefore, a second time the man who was blind, and they said to him, `Give glory to God, we have known that this man is a sinner;'
translations.web: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

translations.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
translations.ylt: he answered, therefore, and said, `If he be a sinner--I have not known, one thing I have known, that, being blind, now I see.'
translations.web: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

translations.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
translations.ylt: And they said to him again, `What did he to thee? how did he open thine eyes?'
translations.web: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

translations.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
translations.ylt: He answered them, `I told you already, and ye did not hear; why again do ye wish to hear? do ye also wish to become his disciples?'
translations.web: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

translations.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.
translations.ylt: They reviled him, therefore, and said, `Thou art his disciple, and we are Moses' disciples;
translations.web: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

translations.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
translations.ylt: we have known that God hath spoken to Moses, but this one--we have not known whence he is.'
translations.web: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

translations.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
translations.ylt: The man answered and said to them, `Why, in this is a wonderful thing, that ye have not known whence he is, and he opened my eyes!
translations.web: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

translations.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
translations.ylt: and we have known that God doth not hear sinners, but, if any one may be a worshipper of God, and may do His will, him He doth hear;
translations.web: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

translations.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
translations.ylt: from the age it was not heard, that any one did open eyes of one who hath been born blind;
translations.web: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

translations.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
translations.ylt: if this one were not from God, he were not able to do anything.'
translations.web: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
translations.ylt: They answered and said to him, `In sins thou wast born altogether, and thou dost teach us!' and they cast him forth without.
translations.web: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

translations.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
translations.ylt: Jesus heard that they cast him forth without, and having found him, he said to him, `Dost thou believe in the Son of God?'
translations.web: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

translations.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
translations.ylt: he answered and said, `Who is he, sir, that I may believe in him?'
translations.web: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `Thou hast both seen him, and he who is speaking with thee is he;'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

translations.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
translations.ylt: and he said, `I believe, sir,' and bowed before him.
translations.web: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `For judgment I to this world did come, that those not seeing may see, and those seeing may become blind.'
translations.web: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

translations.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
translations.ylt: And those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and they said to him, `Are we also blind?'
translations.web: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
