translations.ylt: Jesus said to them, `If ye were blind, ye were not having had sin, but now ye say--We see, therefore doth your sin remain.
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is not entering through the door to the fold of the sheep, but is going up from another side, that one is a thief and a robber;
translations.web: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

translations.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
translations.ylt: and he who is entering through the door is shepherd of the sheep;
translations.web: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

translations.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
translations.ylt: to this one the doorkeeper doth open, and the sheep hear his voice, and his own sheep he doth call by name, and doth lead them forth;
translations.web: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

translations.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
translations.ylt: and when his own sheep he may put forth, before them he goeth on, and the sheep follow him, because they have known his voice;
translations.web: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

translations.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
translations.ylt: and a stranger they will not follow, but will flee from him, because they have not known the voice of strangers.'
translations.web: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

translations.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
translations.ylt: This similitude spake Jesus to them, and they knew not what the things were that he was speaking to them;
translations.web: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
translations.ylt: Jesus said therefore again to them, `Verily, verily, I say to you--I am the door of the sheep;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

translations.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
translations.ylt: all, as many as came before me, are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them;
translations.web: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

translations.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
translations.ylt: I am the door, through me if any one may come in, he shall be saved, and he shall come in, and go out, and find pasture.
translations.web: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

translations.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
translations.ylt: `The thief doth not come, except that he may steal, and kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
translations.web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

translations.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
translations.ylt: `I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd his life layeth down for the sheep;
translations.web: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

translations.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
translations.ylt: and the hireling, and not being a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, doth behold the wolf coming, and doth leave the sheep, and doth flee; and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep;
translations.web: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

translations.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
translations.ylt: and the hireling doth flee because he is an hireling, and is not caring for the sheep.
translations.web: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

translations.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
translations.ylt: `I am the good shepherd, and I know my sheep, and am known by mine,
translations.web: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

translations.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
translations.ylt: according as the Father doth know me, and I know the Father, and my life I lay down for the sheep,
translations.web: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

translations.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
translations.ylt: and other sheep I have that are not of this fold, these also it behoveth me to bring, and my voice they will hear, and there shall become one flock--one shepherd.
translations.web: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

translations.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
translations.ylt: `Because of this doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that again I may take it;
translations.web: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

translations.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
translations.ylt: no one doth take it from me, but I lay it down of myself; authority I have to lay it down, and authority I have again to take it; this command I received from my Father.'
translations.web: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

translations.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
translations.ylt: Therefore, again, there came a division among the Jews, because of these words,
translations.web: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

translations.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
translations.ylt: and many of them said, `He hath a demon, and is mad, why do ye hear him?'
translations.web: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

translations.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
translations.ylt: others said, `These sayings are not those of a demoniac; is a demon able blind men's eyes to open?'
translations.web: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

translations.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
translations.ylt: And the dedication in Jerusalem came, and it was winter,
translations.web: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
translations.ylt: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the porch of Solomon,
translations.web: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

translations.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
translations.ylt: the Jews, therefore, came round about him, and said to him, `Till when our soul dost thou hold in suspense? if thou art the Christ, tell us freely.'
translations.web: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `I told you, and ye do not believe; the works that I do in the name of my Father, these testify concerning me;
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

translations.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
translations.ylt: but ye do not believe, for ye are not of my sheep,
translations.web: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

translations.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
translations.ylt: according as I said to you: My sheep my voice do hear, and I know them, and they follow me,
translations.web: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

translations.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
translations.ylt: and life age-during I give to them, and they shall not perish--to the age, and no one shall pluck them out of my hand;
translations.web: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

translations.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
translations.ylt: my Father, who hath given to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to pluck out of the hand of my Father;
translations.web: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

translations.kjv: I and my Father are one.
translations.ylt: I and the Father are one.'
translations.web: I and the Father are one.”

translations.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
translations.ylt: Therefore, again, did the Jews take up stones that they may stone him;
translations.web: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `Many good works did I shew you from my Father; because of which work of them do ye stone me?'
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

translations.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
translations.ylt: The Jews answered him, saying, `For a good work we do not stone thee, but for evil speaking, and because thou, being a man, dost make thyself God.'
translations.web: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `Is it not having been written in your law: I said, ye are gods?
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

translations.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
translations.ylt: if them he did call gods unto whom the word of God came, (and the Writing is not able to be broken,)
translations.web: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

translations.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
translations.ylt: of him whom the Father did sanctify, and send to the world, do ye say--Thou speakest evil, because I said, Son of God I am?
translations.web: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

translations.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
translations.ylt: if I do not the works of my Father, do not believe me;
translations.web: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

translations.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
translations.ylt: and if I do, even if me ye may not believe, the works believe, that ye may know and may believe that in me is the Father, and I in Him.'
translations.web: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

translations.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
translations.ylt: Therefore were they seeking again to seize him, and he went forth out of their hand,
translations.web: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

translations.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
translations.ylt: and went away again to the other side of the Jordan, to the place where John was at first baptizing, and remained there,
translations.web: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

translations.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
translations.ylt: and many came unto him, and said--`John, indeed, did no sign, and all things, as many as John said about this one were true;'
translations.web: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

translations.kjv: And many believed on him there.
translations.ylt: and many did believe in him there.
translations.web: Many believed in him there.

translations.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
translations.ylt: And there was a certain one ailing, Lazarus, from Bethany, of the village of Mary and Martha her sister--
translations.web: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

translations.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
translations.ylt: and it was Mary who did anoint the Lord with ointment, and did wipe his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was ailing--
translations.web: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

translations.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
translations.ylt: therefore sent the sisters unto him, saying, `Sir, lo, he whom thou dost love is ailing;'
translations.web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having heard, said, `This ailment is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified through it.'
translations.web: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

translations.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
translations.ylt: And Jesus was loving Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus,
translations.web: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

translations.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
translations.ylt: when, therefore, he heard that he is ailing, then indeed he remained in the place in which he was two days,
translations.web: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

translations.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judea again.
translations.ylt: then after this, he saith to the disciples, `We may go to Judea again;'
translations.web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

translations.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
translations.ylt: the disciples say to him, `Rabbi, now were the Jews seeking to stone thee, and again thou dost go thither!'
translations.web: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `Are there not twelve hours in the day? if any one may walk in the day, he doth not stumble, because the light of this world he doth see;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

translations.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
translations.ylt: and if any one may walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.'
translations.web: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

translations.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
translations.ylt: These things he said, and after this he saith to them, `Lazarus our friend hath fallen asleep, but I go on that I may awake him;'
translations.web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

translations.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
translations.ylt: therefore said his disciples, `Sir, if he hath fallen asleep, he will be saved;'
translations.web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

translations.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
translations.ylt: but Jesus had spoken about his death, but they thought that about the repose of sleep he speaketh.
translations.web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
translations.ylt: Then, therefore, Jesus said to them freely, `Lazarus hath died;
translations.web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

translations.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
translations.ylt: and I rejoice, for your sake, (that ye may believe,) that I was not there; but we may go to him;'
translations.web: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

translations.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
translations.ylt: therefore said Thomas, who is called Didymus, to the fellow-disciples, `We may go--we also, that we may die with him,'
translations.web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

translations.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, having come, found him having been four days already in the tomb.
translations.web: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

translations.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
translations.ylt: And Bethany was nigh to Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off,
translations.web: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

translations.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
translations.ylt: and many of the Jews had come unto Martha and Mary, that they might comfort them concerning their brother;
translations.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

translations.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
translations.ylt: Martha, therefore, when she heard that Jesus doth come, met him, and Mary kept sitting in the house.
translations.web: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

translations.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
translations.ylt: Martha, therefore, said unto Jesus, `Sir, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died;
translations.web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

translations.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
translations.ylt: but even now, I have known that whatever thou mayest ask of God, God will give to thee;'
translations.web: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Thy brother shall rise again.'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

translations.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
translations.ylt: Martha saith to him, `I have known that he will rise again, in the rising again in the last day;'
translations.web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
translations.ylt: Jesus said to her, `I am the rising again, and the life; he who is believing in me, even if he may die, shall live;
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

translations.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
translations.ylt: and every one who is living and believing in me shall not die--to the age;
translations.web: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

translations.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
translations.ylt: believest thou this?' she saith to him, `Yes, sir, I have believed that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming to the world.'
translations.web: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

translations.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
translations.ylt: And these things having said, she went away, and called Mary her sister privately, saying, `The Teacher is present, and doth call thee;'
translations.web: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

translations.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
translations.ylt: she, when she heard, riseth up quickly, and doth come to him;
translations.web: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

translations.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
translations.ylt: and Jesus had not yet come to the village, but was in the place where Martha met him;
translations.web: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

translations.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
translations.ylt: the Jews, therefore, who were with her in the house, and were comforting her, having seen Mary that she rose up quickly and went forth, followed her, saying--`She doth go away to the tomb, that she may weep there.'
translations.web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

translations.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
translations.ylt: Mary, therefore, when she came where Jesus was, having seen him, fell at his feet, saying to him, `Sir, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died;'
translations.web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, when he saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her weeping, did groan in the spirit, and troubled himself, and he said,
translations.web: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

translations.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
translations.ylt: `Where have ye laid him?' they say to him, `Sir, come and see;'
translations.web: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

translations.kjv: Jesus wept.
translations.ylt: Jesus wept.
translations.web: Jesus wept.

translations.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, said, `Lo, how he was loving him!'
translations.web: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

translations.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
translations.ylt: and certain of them said, `Was not this one, who did open the eyes of the blind man, able to cause that also this one might not have died?'
translations.web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

translations.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, again groaning in himself, cometh to the tomb, and it was a cave, and a stone was lying upon it,
translations.web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

translations.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith, `Take ye away the stone;' the sister of him who hath died--Martha--saith to him, `Sir, already he stinketh, for he is four days dead;'
translations.web: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Said I not to thee, that if thou mayest believe, thou shalt see the glory of God?'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

translations.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
translations.ylt: They took away, therefore, the stone where the dead was laid, and Jesus lifted his eyes upwards, and said, `Father, I thank Thee, that Thou didst hear me;
translations.web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

translations.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
translations.ylt: and I knew that Thou always dost hear me, but, because of the multitude that is standing by, I said it, that they may believe that Thou didst send me.'
translations.web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

translations.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
translations.ylt: And these things saying, with a loud voice he cried out, `Lazarus, come forth;'
translations.web: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

translations.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
translations.ylt: and he who died came forth, being bound feet and hands with grave-clothes, and his visage with a napkin was bound about; Jesus saith to them, `Loose him, and suffer to go.'
translations.web: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

translations.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
translations.ylt: Many, therefore, of the Jews who came unto Mary, and beheld what Jesus did, believed in him;
translations.web: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

translations.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
translations.ylt: but certain of them went away unto the Pharisees, and told them what Jesus did;
translations.web: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

translations.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
translations.ylt: the chief priests, therefore, and the Pharisees, gathered together a sanhedrim, and said, `What may we do? because this man doth many signs?
translations.web: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

translations.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
translations.ylt: if we may let him alone thus, all will believe in him; and the Romans will come, and will take away both our place and nation.'
translations.web: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

translations.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
translations.ylt: and a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being chief priest of that year, said to them, `Ye have not known anything,
translations.web: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

translations.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
translations.ylt: nor reason that it is good for us that one man may die for the people, and not the whole nation perish.'
translations.web: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

translations.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
translations.ylt: And this he said not of himself, but being chief priest of that year, he did prophesy that Jesus was about to die for the nation,
translations.web: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

translations.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
translations.ylt: and not for the nation only, but that also the children of God, who have been scattered abroad, he may gather together into one.
translations.web: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

translations.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
translations.ylt: From that day, therefore, they took counsel together that they may kill him;
translations.web: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

translations.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, was no more freely walking among the Jews, but went away thence to the region nigh the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim, and there he tarried with his disciples.
translations.web: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

translations.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
translations.ylt: And the passover of the Jews was nigh, and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, that they might purify themselves;
translations.web: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

translations.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
translations.ylt: they were seeking, therefore, Jesus, and said one with another, standing in the temple, `What doth appear to you--that he may not come to the feast?'
translations.web: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

translations.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
translations.ylt: and both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a command, that if any one may know where he is, he may shew it, so that they may seize him.
translations.web: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, six days before the passover, came to Bethany, where was Lazarus, who had died, whom he raised out of the dead;
translations.web: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

translations.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
translations.ylt: they made, therefore, to him a supper there, and Martha was ministering, and Lazarus was one of those reclining together (at meat) with him;
translations.web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

translations.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
translations.ylt: Mary, therefore, having taken a pound of ointment of spikenard, of great price, anointed the feet of Jesus and did wipe with her hair his feet, and the house was filled from the fragrance of the ointment.
translations.web: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

translations.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,
translations.ylt: Therefore saith one of his disciples--Judas Iscariot, of Simon, who is about to deliver him up--
translations.web: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

translations.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
translations.ylt: `Wherefore was not this ointment sold for three hundred denaries, and given to the poor?'
translations.web: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

translations.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
translations.ylt: and he said this, not because he was caring for the poor, but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and what things were put in he was carrying.
translations.web: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said, `Suffer her; for the day of my embalming she hath kept it,
translations.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

translations.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
translations.ylt: for the poor ye have always with yourselves, and me ye have not always.'
translations.web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

translations.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
translations.ylt: A great multitude, therefore, of the Jews knew that he is there, and they came, not because of Jesus only, but that Lazarus also they may see, whom he raised out of the dead;
translations.web: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

translations.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
translations.ylt: and the chief priests took counsel, that also Lazarus they may kill,
translations.web: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

translations.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
translations.ylt: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away, and were believing in Jesus.
translations.web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

translations.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
translations.ylt: On the morrow, a great multitude that came to the feast, having heard that Jesus doth come to Jerusalem,
translations.web: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

translations.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
translations.ylt: took the branches of the palms, and went forth to meet him, and were crying, `Hosanna, blessed is he who is coming in the name of the Lord--the king of Israel;'
translations.web: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
translations.ylt: and Jesus having found a young ass did sit upon it, according as it is written,
translations.web: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

translations.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
translations.ylt: `Fear not, daughter of Sion, lo, thy king doth come, sitting on an ass' colt.'
translations.web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

translations.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
translations.ylt: And these things his disciples did not know at the first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were having been written about him, and these things they did to him.
translations.web: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

translations.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
translations.ylt: The multitude, therefore, who are with him, were testifying that he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and did raise him out of the dead;
translations.web: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

translations.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
translations.ylt: because of this also did the multitude meet him, because they heard of his having done this sign,
translations.web: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

translations.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
translations.ylt: the Pharisees, therefore, said among themselves, `Ye see that ye do not gain anything, lo, the world did go after him.'
translations.web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

translations.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
translations.ylt: And there were certain Greeks out of those coming up that they may worship in the feast,
translations.web: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

translations.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
translations.ylt: these then came near to Philip, who is from Bethsaida of Galilee, and were asking him, saying, `Sir, we wish to see Jesus;'
translations.web: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

translations.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
translations.ylt: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew, and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
translations.web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
translations.ylt: And Jesus responded to them, saying, `The hour hath come that the Son of Man may be glorified;
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to you, if the grain of the wheat, having fallen to the earth, may not die, itself remaineth alone; and if it may die, it doth bear much fruit;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

translations.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
translations.ylt: he who is loving his life shall lose it, and he who is hating his life in this world--to life age-during shall keep it;
translations.web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

translations.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
translations.ylt: if any one may minister to me, let him follow me, and where I am, there also my ministrant shall be; and if any one may minister to me--honour him will the Father.
translations.web: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

translations.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
translations.ylt: `Now hath my soul been troubled, and what? shall I say--Father, save me from this hour? --but because of this I came to this hour;
translations.web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

translations.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
translations.ylt: Father, glorify Thy name.' There came, therefore, a voice out of the heaven, `I both glorified, and again I will glorify it;'
translations.web: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

translations.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
translations.ylt: the multitude, therefore, having stood and heard, were saying that there hath been thunder; others said, `A messenger hath spoken to him.'
translations.web: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said, `Not because of me hath this voice come, but because of you;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

translations.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
translations.ylt: now is a judgment of this world, now shall the ruler of this world be cast forth;
translations.web: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

translations.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
translations.ylt: and I, if I may be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.'
translations.web: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

translations.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
translations.ylt: And this he said signifying by what death he was about to die;
translations.web: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

translations.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
translations.ylt: the multitude answered him, `We heard out of the law that the Christ doth remain--to the age; and how dost thou say, That it behoveth the Son of Man to be lifted up? who is this--the Son of Man?'
translations.web: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them, `Yet a little time is the light with you; walk while ye have the light, that darkness may not overtake you; and he who is walking in the darkness hath not known where he goeth;
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

translations.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
translations.ylt: while ye have the light, believe in the light, that sons of light ye may become.' These things spake Jesus, and having gone away, he was hid from them,
translations.web: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

translations.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
translations.ylt: yet he having done so many signs before them, they were not believing in him,
translations.web: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

translations.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
translations.ylt: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he said, `Lord, who gave credence to our report? and the arm of the Lord--to whom was it revealed?'
translations.web: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

translations.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
translations.ylt: Because of this they were not able to believe, that again Isaiah said,
translations.web: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

translations.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
translations.ylt: `He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart, that they might not see with the eyes, and understand with the heart, and turn back, and I might heal them;'
translations.web: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

translations.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
translations.ylt: these things said Isaiah, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
translations.web: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
translations.ylt: Still, however, also out of the rulers did many believe in him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing, that they might not be put out of the synagogue,
translations.web: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

translations.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
translations.ylt: for they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.
translations.web: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

translations.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus cried and said, `He who is believing in me, doth not believe in me, but in Him who sent me;
translations.web: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

translations.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
translations.ylt: and he who is beholding me, doth behold Him who sent me;
translations.web: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

translations.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
translations.ylt: I a light to the world have come, that every one who is believing in me--in the darkness may not remain;
translations.web: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

translations.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
translations.ylt: and if any one may hear my sayings, and not believe, I--I do not judge him, for I came not that I might judge the world, but that I might save the world.
translations.web: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

translations.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
translations.ylt: `He who is rejecting me, and not receiving my sayings, hath one who is judging him, the word that I spake, that will judge him in the last day,
translations.web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

translations.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
translations.ylt: because I spake not from myself, but the Father who sent me, He did give me a command, what I may say, and what I may speak,
translations.web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

translations.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
translations.ylt: and I have known that His command is life age-during; what, therefore, I speak, according as the Father hath said to me, so I speak.'
translations.web: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

translations.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
translations.ylt: And before the feast of the passover, Jesus knowing that his hour hath come, that he may remove out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own who are in the world--to the end he loved them.
translations.web: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

translations.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;
translations.ylt: And supper being come, the devil already having put it into the heart of Judas of Simon, Iscariot, that he may deliver him up,
translations.web: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

translations.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
translations.ylt: Jesus knowing that all things the Father hath given to him--into his hands, and that from God he came forth, and unto God he goeth,
translations.web: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

translations.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
translations.ylt: doth rise from the supper, and doth lay down his garments, and having taken a towel, he girded himself;
translations.web: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

translations.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
translations.ylt: afterward he putteth water into the basin, and began to wash the feet of his disciples, and to wipe with the towel with which he was being girded.
translations.web: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

translations.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
translations.ylt: He cometh, therefore, unto Simon Peter, and that one saith to him, `Sir, thou--dost thou wash my feet?'
translations.web: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to him, `That which I do thou hast not known now, but thou shalt know after these things;'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

translations.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
translations.ylt: Peter saith to him, `Thou mayest not wash my feet--to the age.' Jesus answered him, `If I may not wash thee, thou hast no part with me;'
translations.web: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

translations.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter saith to him, `Sir, not my feet only, but also the hands and the head.'
translations.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `He who hath been bathed hath no need save to wash his feet, but he is clean altogether; and ye are clean, but not all;'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

translations.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
translations.ylt: for he knew him who is delivering him up; because of this he said, `Ye are not all clean.'
translations.web: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

translations.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
translations.ylt: When, therefore, he washed their feet, and took his garments, having reclined (at meat) again, he said to them, `Do ye know what I have done to you?
translations.web: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

translations.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
translations.ylt: ye call me, The Teacher and The Lord, and ye say well, for I am;
translations.web: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

translations.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
translations.ylt: if then I did wash your feet--the Lord and the Teacher--ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
translations.web: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

translations.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
translations.ylt: `For an example I gave to you, that, according as I did to you, ye also may do;
translations.web: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his lord, nor an apostle greater than he who sent him;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

translations.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
translations.ylt: if these things ye have known, happy are ye, if ye may do them;
translations.web: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

translations.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
translations.ylt: not concerning you all do I speak; I have known whom I chose for myself; but that the Writing may be fulfilled: He who is eating the bread with me, did lift up against me his heel.
translations.web: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

translations.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
translations.ylt: `From this time I tell you, before its coming to pass, that, when it may come to pass, ye may believe that I am he;
translations.web: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to you, he who is receiving whomsoever I may send, doth receive me; and he who is receiving me, doth receive Him who sent me.'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
translations.ylt: These things having said, Jesus was troubled in the spirit, and did testify, and said, `Verily, verily, I say to you, that one of you will deliver me up;'
translations.web: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

translations.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
translations.ylt: the disciples were looking, therefore, one at another, doubting concerning whom he speaketh.
translations.web: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

translations.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
translations.ylt: And there was one of his disciples reclining (at meat) in the bosom of Jesus, whom Jesus was loving;
translations.web: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

translations.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter, then, doth beckon to this one, to inquire who he may be concerning whom he speaketh,
translations.web: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

translations.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
translations.ylt: and that one having leant back on the breast of Jesus, respondeth to him, `Sir, who is it?'
translations.web: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
translations.ylt: Jesus answereth, `That one it is to whom I, having dipped the morsel, shall give it;' and having dipped the morsel, he giveth it to Judas of Simon, Iscariot.
translations.web: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

translations.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
translations.ylt: And after the morsel, then the Adversary entered into that one, Jesus, therefore, saith to him, `What thou dost--do quickly;'
translations.web: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

translations.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
translations.ylt: and none of those reclining at meat knew for what intent he said this to him,
translations.web: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

translations.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
translations.ylt: for certain were thinking, since Judas had the bag, that Jesus saith to him, `Buy what we have need of for the feast;' or that he may give something to the poor;
translations.web: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

translations.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
translations.ylt: having received, therefore, the morsel, that one immediately went forth, and it was night.
translations.web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

translations.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
translations.ylt: When, therefore, he went forth, Jesus saith, `Now was the Son of Man glorified, and God was glorified in him;
translations.web: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

translations.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
translations.ylt: if God was glorified in him, God also will glorify him in Himself; yea, immediately He will glorify him.
translations.web: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

translations.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
translations.ylt: `Little children, yet a little am I with you; ye will seek me, and, according as I said to the Jews--Whither I go away, ye are not able to come, to you also I do say it now.
translations.web: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

translations.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
translations.ylt: `A new commandment I give to you, that ye love one another; according as I did love you, that ye also love one another;
translations.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

translations.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
translations.ylt: in this shall all know that ye are my disciples, if ye may have love one to another.'
translations.web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

translations.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter saith to him, `Sir, whither dost thou go away?' Jesus answered him, `Whither I go away, thou art not able now to follow me, but afterward thou shalt follow me.'
translations.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

translations.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
translations.ylt: Peter saith to him, `Sir, wherefore am I not able to follow thee now? my life for thee I will lay down;'
translations.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered him, `Thy life for me thou wilt lay down! verily, verily, I say to thee, a cock will not crow till thou mayest deny me thrice.'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

translations.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
translations.ylt: `Let not your heart be troubled, believe in God, also in me believe;
translations.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

translations.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
translations.ylt: in the house of my Father are many mansions; and if not, I would have told you; I go on to prepare a place for you;
translations.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

translations.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
translations.ylt: and if I go on and prepare for you a place, again do I come, and will receive you unto myself, that where I am ye also may be;
translations.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

translations.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
translations.ylt: and whither I go away ye have known, and the way ye have known.'
translations.web: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

translations.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
translations.ylt: Thomas saith to him, `Sir, we have not known whither thou goest away, and how are we able to know the way?'
translations.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `I am the way, and the truth, and the life, no one doth come unto the Father, if not through me;
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

translations.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
translations.ylt: if ye had known me, my Father also ye would have known, and from this time ye have known Him, and have seen Him.'
translations.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

translations.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
translations.ylt: Philip saith to him, `Sir, shew to us the Father, and it is enough for us;'
translations.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `So long time am I with you, and thou hast not known me, Philip? he who hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how dost thou say, Shew to us the Father?
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

translations.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
translations.ylt: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father is in me? the sayings that I speak to you, from myself I speak not, and the Father who is abiding in me, Himself doth the works;
translations.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

translations.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
translations.ylt: believe me, that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; and if not, because of the works themselves, believe me.
translations.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
translations.ylt: `Verily, verily, I say to you, he who is believing in me, the works that I do--that one also shall do, and greater than these he shall do, because I go on to my Father;
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

translations.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
translations.ylt: and whatever ye may ask in my name, I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son;
translations.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

translations.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
translations.ylt: if ye ask anything in my name I will do it.
translations.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

translations.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
translations.ylt: `If ye love me, my commands keep,
translations.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.

translations.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
translations.ylt: and I will ask the Father, and another Comforter He will give to you, that he may remain with you--to the age;
translations.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

translations.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
translations.ylt: the Spirit of truth, whom the world is not able to receive, because it doth not behold him, nor know him, and ye know him, because he doth remain with you, and shall be in you.
translations.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

translations.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
translations.ylt: `I will not leave you bereaved, I come unto you;
translations.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

translations.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
translations.ylt: yet a little, and the world doth no more behold me, and ye behold me, because I live, and ye shall live;
translations.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

translations.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
translations.ylt: in that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you;
translations.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

translations.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
translations.ylt: he who is having my commands, and is keeping them, that one it is who is loving me, and he who is loving me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.'
translations.web: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

translations.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
translations.ylt: Judas saith to him, (not the Iscariot), `Sir, what hath come to pass, that to us thou are about to manifest thyself, and not to the world?'
translations.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
