translations.ylt: Jesus answered and said to him, `If any one may love me, my word he will keep, and my Father will love him, and unto him we will come, and abode with him we will make;
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

translations.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
translations.ylt: he who is not loving me, my words doth not keep; and the word that ye hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.
translations.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

translations.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
translations.ylt: `These things I have spoken to you, remaining with you,
translations.web: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

translations.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
translations.ylt: and the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and remind you of all things that I said to you.
translations.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

translations.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
translations.ylt: `Peace I leave to you; my peace I give to you, not according as the world doth give do I give to you; let not your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid;
translations.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

translations.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
translations.ylt: ye heard that I said to you--I go away, and I come unto you; if ye did love me, ye would have rejoiced that I said--I go on to the Father, because my Father is greater than I.
translations.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

translations.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
translations.ylt: `And now I have said it to you before it come to pass, that when it may come to pass, ye may believe;
translations.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

translations.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
translations.ylt: I will no more talk much with you, for the ruler of this world doth come, and in me he hath nothing;
translations.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

translations.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
translations.ylt: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and according as the Father gave me command so I do; arise, we may go hence.
translations.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

translations.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
translations.ylt: `I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman;
translations.web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

translations.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
translations.ylt: every branch in me not bearing fruit, He doth take it away, and every one bearing fruit, He doth cleanse by pruning it, that it may bear more fruit;
translations.web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

translations.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
translations.ylt: already ye are clean, because of the word that I have spoken to you;
translations.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

translations.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
translations.ylt: remain in me, and I in you, as the branch is not able to bear fruit of itself, if it may not remain in the vine, so neither ye, if ye may not remain in me.
translations.web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

translations.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
translations.ylt: `I am the vine, ye the branches; he who is remaining in me, and I in him, this one doth bear much fruit, because apart from me ye are not able to do anything;
translations.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

translations.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
translations.ylt: if any one may not remain in me, he was cast forth without as the branch, and was withered, and they gather them, and cast to fire, and they are burned;
translations.web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

translations.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
translations.ylt: if ye may remain in me, and my sayings in you may remain, whatever ye may wish ye shall ask, and it shall be done to you.
translations.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

translations.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
translations.ylt: `In this was my Father glorified, that ye may bear much fruit, and ye shall become my disciples.
translations.web: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

translations.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
translations.ylt: According as the Father did love me, I also loved you, remain in my love;
translations.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

translations.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
translations.ylt: if my commandments ye may keep, ye shall remain in my love, according as I the commands of my Father have kept, and do remain in His love;
translations.web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

translations.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
translations.ylt: these things I have spoken to you, that my joy in you may remain, and your joy may be full.
translations.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

translations.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
translations.ylt: `This is my command, that ye love one another, according as I did love you;
translations.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

translations.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
translations.ylt: greater love than this hath no one, that any one his life may lay down for his friends;
translations.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

translations.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
translations.ylt: ye are my friends, if ye may do whatever I command you;
translations.web: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

translations.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
translations.ylt: no more do I call you servants, because the servant hath not known what his lord doth, and you I have called friends, because all things that I heard from my Father, I did make known to you.
translations.web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

translations.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
translations.ylt: `Ye did not choose out me, but I chose out you, and did appoint you, that ye might go away, and might bear fruit, and your fruit might remain, that whatever ye may ask of the Father in my name, He may give you.
translations.web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

translations.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
translations.ylt: `These things I command you, that ye love one another;
translations.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

translations.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
translations.ylt: if the world doth hate you, ye know that it hath hated me before you;
translations.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

translations.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
translations.ylt: if of the world ye were, the world its own would have been loving, and because of the world ye are not--but I chose out of the world--because of this the world hateth you.
translations.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

translations.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
translations.ylt: `Remember the word that I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; if me they did persecute, you also they will persecute; if my word they did keep, yours also they will keep;
translations.web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

translations.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
translations.ylt: but all these things will they do to you, because of my name, because they have not known Him who sent me;
translations.web: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

translations.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
translations.ylt: if I had not come and spoken to them, they were not having sin; but now pretext they have not for their sin.
translations.web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

translations.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
translations.ylt: `He who is hating me, doth hate also my Father;
translations.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

translations.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
translations.ylt: if I did not do among them the works that no other hath done, they were not having sin, and now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father;
translations.web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

translations.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
translations.ylt: but--that the word may be fulfilled that was written in their law--They hated me without a cause.
translations.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

translations.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
translations.ylt: `And when the Comforter may come, whom I will send to you from the Father--the Spirit of truth, who from the Father doth come forth, he will testify of me;
translations.web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

translations.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
translations.ylt: and ye also do testify, because from the beginning ye are with me.
translations.web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

translations.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
translations.ylt: `These things I have spoken to you, that ye may not be stumbled,
translations.web: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

translations.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
translations.ylt: out of the synagogues they will put you; but an hour doth come, that every one who hath killed you, may think to offer service unto God;
translations.web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

translations.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
translations.ylt: and these things they will do to you, because they did not know the Father, nor me.
translations.web: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

translations.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
translations.ylt: `But these things I have spoken to you, that when the hour may come, ye may remember them, that I said them to you, and these things to you from the beginning I did not say, because I was with you;
translations.web: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

translations.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
translations.ylt: and now I go away to Him who sent me, and none of you doth ask me, Whither dost thou go?
translations.web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

translations.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
translations.ylt: but because these things I have said to you, the sorrow hath filled your heart.
translations.web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
translations.ylt: `But I tell you the truth; it is better for you that I go away, for if I may not go away, the Comforter will not come unto you, and if I go on, I will send Him unto you;
translations.web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

translations.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
translations.ylt: and having come, He will convict the world concerning sin, and concerning righteousness, and concerning judgment;
translations.web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

translations.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
translations.ylt: concerning sin indeed, because they do not believe in me;
translations.web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

translations.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
translations.ylt: and concerning righteousness, because unto my Father I go away, and no more do ye behold me;
translations.web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

translations.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
translations.ylt: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world hath been judged.
translations.web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

translations.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
translations.ylt: `I have yet many things to say to you, but ye are not able to bear them now;
translations.web: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

translations.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
translations.ylt: and when He may come--the Spirit of truth--He will guide you to all the truth, for He will not speak from Himself, but as many things as He will hear He will speak, and the coming things He will tell you;
translations.web: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

translations.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
translations.ylt: He will glorify me, because of mine He will take, and will tell to you.
translations.web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

translations.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
translations.ylt: `All things, as many as the Father hath, are mine; because of this I said, That of mine He will take, and will tell to you;
translations.web: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

translations.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
translations.ylt: a little while, and ye do not behold me, and again a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go away unto the Father.'
translations.web: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

translations.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
translations.ylt: Therefore said some of his disciples one to another, `What is this that he saith to us, A little while, and ye do not behold me, and again a little while, and ye shall see me, and, Because I go away unto the Father?'
translations.web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

translations.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
translations.ylt: they said then, `What is this he saith--the little while? we have not known what he saith.'
translations.web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

translations.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, knew that they were wishing to ask him, and he said to them, `Concerning this do ye seek one with another, because I said, A little while, and you do not behold me, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?
translations.web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to you, that ye shall weep and lament, and the world will rejoice; and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow joy will become.
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

translations.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
translations.ylt: `The woman, when she may bear, hath sorrow, because her hour did come, and when she may bear the child, no more doth she remember the anguish, because of the joy that a man was born to the world.
translations.web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

translations.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
translations.ylt: `And ye, therefore, now, indeed, have sorrow; and again I will see you, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one doth take from you,
translations.web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

translations.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
translations.ylt: and in that day ye will question me nothing; verily, verily, I say to you, as many things as ye may ask of the Father in my name, He will give you;
translations.web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

translations.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
translations.ylt: till now ye did ask nothing in my name; ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
translations.web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

translations.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
translations.ylt: `These things in similitudes I have spoken to you, but there cometh an hour when no more in similitudes will I speak to you, but freely of the Father, will tell you.
translations.web: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

translations.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
translations.ylt: `In that day, in my name ye will make request, and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father for you,
translations.web: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

translations.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
translations.ylt: for the Father himself doth love you, because me ye have loved, and ye have believed that I from God came forth;
translations.web: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

translations.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
translations.ylt: I came forth from the Father, and have come to the world; again I leave the world, and go on unto the Father.'
translations.web: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

translations.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
translations.ylt: His disciples say to him, `Lo, now freely thou dost speak, and no similitude speakest thou;
translations.web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

translations.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
translations.ylt: now we have known that thou hast known all things, and hast no need that any one do question thee; in this we believe that from God thou didst come forth.'
translations.web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered them, `Now do ye believe? lo, there doth come an hour,
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

translations.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
translations.ylt: and now it hath come, that ye may be scattered, each to his own things, and me ye may leave alone, and I am not alone, because the Father is with me;
translations.web: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

translations.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
translations.ylt: these things I have spoken to you, that in me ye may have peace, in the world ye shall have tribulation, but take courage--I have overcome the world.'
translations.web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

translations.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
translations.ylt: These things spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to the heaven, and said--`Father, the hour hath come, glorify Thy Son, that Thy Son also may glorify Thee,
translations.web: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

translations.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
translations.ylt: according as Thou didst give to him authority over all flesh, that--all that Thou hast given to him--he may give to them life age-during;
translations.web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

translations.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
translations.ylt: and this is the life age-during, that they may know Thee, the only true God, and him whom Thou didst send--Jesus Christ;
translations.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
translations.ylt: I did glorify Thee on the earth, the work I did finish that Thou hast given me, that I may do it.
translations.web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

translations.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
translations.ylt: `And now, glorify me, Thou Father, with Thyself, with the glory that I had before the world was, with Thee;
translations.web: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

translations.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
translations.ylt: I did manifest Thy name to the men whom Thou hast given to me out of the world; Thine they were, and to me Thou hast given them, and Thy word they have kept;
translations.web: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

translations.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
translations.ylt: now they have known that all things, as many as Thou hast given to me, are from Thee,
translations.web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

translations.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
translations.ylt: because the sayings that Thou hast given to me, I have given to them, and they themselves received, and have known truly, that from Thee I came forth, and they did believe that Thou didst send me.
translations.web: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

translations.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
translations.ylt: `I ask in regard to them; not in regard to the world do I ask, but in regard to those whom Thou hast given to me, because Thine they are,
translations.web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

translations.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
translations.ylt: and all mine are Thine, and Thine are mine, and I have been glorified in them;
translations.web: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

translations.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
translations.ylt: and no more am I in the world, and these are in the world, and I come unto Thee. Holy Father, keep them in Thy name, whom Thou hast given to me, that they may be one as we;
translations.web: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

translations.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: when I was with them in the world, I was keeping them in Thy name; those whom Thou hast given to me I did guard, and none of them was destroyed, except the son of the destruction, that the Writing may be fulfilled.
translations.web: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

translations.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
translations.ylt: `And now unto Thee I come, and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves;
translations.web: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

translations.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
translations.ylt: I have given to them Thy word, and the world did hate them, because they are not of the world, as I am not of the world;
translations.web: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

translations.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
translations.ylt: I do not ask that Thou mayest take them out of the world, but that Thou mayest keep them out of the evil.
translations.web: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

translations.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
translations.ylt: `Of the world they are not, as I of the world am not;
translations.web: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

translations.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
translations.ylt: sanctify them in Thy truth, Thy word is truth;
translations.web: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

translations.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
translations.ylt: as Thou didst send me to the world, I also did send them to the world;
translations.web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

translations.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
translations.ylt: and for them do I sanctify myself, that they also themselves may be sanctified in truth.
translations.web: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

translations.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
translations.ylt: `And not in regard to these alone do I ask, but also in regard to those who shall be believing, through their word, in me;
translations.web: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

translations.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
translations.ylt: that they all may be one, as Thou Father art in me, and I in Thee; that they also in us may be one, that the world may believe that Thou didst send me.
translations.web: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

translations.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
translations.ylt: `And I, the glory that thou hast given to me, have given to them, that they may be one as we are one;
translations.web: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

translations.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
translations.ylt: I in them, and Thou in me, that they may be perfected into one, and that the world may know that Thou didst send me, and didst love them as Thou didst love me.
translations.web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

translations.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
translations.ylt: `Father, those whom Thou hast given to me, I will that where I am they also may be with me, that they may behold my glory that Thou didst give to me, because Thou didst love me before the foundation of the world.
translations.web: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

translations.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
translations.ylt: `Righteous Father, also the world did not know Thee, and I knew Thee, and these have known that Thou didst send me,
translations.web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

translations.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
translations.ylt: and I made known to them Thy name, and will make known, that the love with which Thou lovedst me in them may be, and I in them.'
translations.web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

translations.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
translations.ylt: These things having said, Jesus went forth with his disciples beyond the brook of Kedron, where was a garden, into which he entered, himself and his disciples,
translations.web: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

translations.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
translations.ylt: and Judas also, who delivered him up, had known the place, because many times did Jesus assemble there with his disciples.
translations.web: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

translations.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
translations.ylt: Judas, therefore, having taken the band and officers out of the chief priests and Pharisees, doth come thither with torches and lamps, and weapons;
translations.web: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

translations.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, knowing all things that are coming upon him, having gone forth, said to them, `Whom do ye seek?'
translations.web: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

translations.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
translations.ylt: they answered him, `Jesus the Nazarene;' Jesus saith to them, `I am he;' --and Judas who delivered him up was standing with them; --
translations.web: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

translations.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
translations.ylt: when, therefore, he said to them--`I am he,' they went away backward, and fell to the ground.
translations.web: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

translations.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.ylt: Again, therefore, he questioned them, `Whom do ye seek?' and they said, `Jesus the Nazarene;'
translations.web: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `I said to you that I am he; if, then, me ye seek, suffer these to go away;'
translations.web: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

translations.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
translations.ylt: that the word might be fulfilled that he said--`Those whom Thou hast given to me, I did not lose of them even one.'
translations.web: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

translations.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter, therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the chief priest's servant, and cut off his right ear--and the name of the servant was Malchus--
translations.web: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to Peter, `Put the sword into the sheath; the cup that the Father hath given to me, may I not drink it?'
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

translations.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
translations.ylt: The band, therefore, and the captain, and the officers of the Jews, took hold on Jesus, and bound him,
translations.web: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

translations.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
translations.ylt: and they led him away to Annas first, for he was father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was chief priest of that year,
translations.web: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

translations.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
translations.ylt: and Caiaphas was he who gave counsel to the Jews, that it is good for one man to perish for the people.
translations.web: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

translations.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
translations.ylt: And following Jesus was Simon Peter, and the other disciple, and that disciple was known to the chief priest, and he entered with Jesus to the hall of the chief priest,
translations.web: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

translations.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
translations.ylt: and Peter was standing at the door without, therefore went forth the other disciple who was known to the chief priest, and he spake to the female keeping the door, and he brought in Peter.
translations.web: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

translations.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
translations.ylt: Then said the maid keeping the door to Peter, `Art thou also of the disciples of this man?' he saith, `I am not;'
translations.web: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

translations.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
translations.ylt: and the servants and the officers were standing, having made a fire of coals, because it was cold, and they were warming themselves, and Peter was standing with them, and warming himself.
translations.web: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

translations.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
translations.ylt: The chief priests, therefore, questioned Jesus concerning his disciples, and concerning his teaching;
translations.web: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered him, `I spake freely to the world, I did always teach in a synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews do always come together; and in secret I spake nothing;
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

translations.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
translations.ylt: why me dost thou question? question those having heard what I spake to them; lo, these have known what I said.'
translations.web: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

translations.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
translations.ylt: And he having said these things, one of the officers standing by did give Jesus a slap, saying, `Thus dost thou answer the chief priest?'
translations.web: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered him, `If I spake ill, testify concerning the ill; and if well, why me dost thou smite?'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

translations.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
translations.ylt: Annas then sent him bound to Caiaphas the chief priest.
translations.web: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

translations.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
translations.ylt: And Simon Peter was standing and warming himself, they said then to him, `Art thou also of his disciples?' he denied, and said, `I am not.'
translations.web: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

translations.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
translations.ylt: One of the servants of the chief priest, being kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, saith, `Did not I see thee in the garden with him?'
translations.web: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

translations.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
translations.ylt: again, therefore, Peter denied, and immediately a cock crew.
translations.web: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

translations.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
translations.ylt: They led, therefore, Jesus from Caiaphas to the praetorium, and it was early, and they themselves did not enter into the praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but that they might eat the passover;
translations.web: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

translations.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, went forth unto them, and said, `What accusation do ye bring against this man?'
translations.web: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
translations.ylt: they answered and said to him, `If he were not an evil doer, we had not delivered him to thee.'
translations.web: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

translations.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, said to them, `Take ye him--ye--and according to your law judge him;' the Jews, therefore, said to him, `It is not lawful to us to put any one to death;'
translations.web: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

translations.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
translations.ylt: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled which he said, signifying by what death he was about to die.
translations.web: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

translations.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, entered into the praetorium again, and called Jesus, and said to him, `Thou art the King of the Jews?'
translations.web: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
translations.ylt: Jesus answered him, `From thyself dost thou say this? or did others say it to thee about me?'
translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

translations.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
translations.ylt: Pilate answered, `Am I a Jew? thy nation, and the chief priests did deliver thee up to me; what didst thou?'
translations.web: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `My kingdom is not of this world; if my kingdom were of this world, my officers had struggled that I might not be delivered up to Jews; but now my kingdom is not from hence.'
translations.web: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

translations.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, said to him, `Art thou then a king?' Jesus answered, `Thou dost say it; because a king I am, I for this have been born, and for this I have come to the world, that I may testify to the truth; every one who is of the truth, doth hear my voice.'
translations.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

translations.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
translations.ylt: Pilate saith to him, `What is truth?' and this having said, again he went forth unto the Jews, and saith to them, `I do find no fault in him;
translations.web: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

translations.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
translations.ylt: and ye have a custom that I shall release to you one in the passover; will ye, therefore, that I shall release to you the king of the Jews?'
translations.web: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

translations.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
translations.ylt: therefore they all cried out again, saying, `Not this one--but Barabbas;' and Barabbas was a robber.
translations.web: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

translations.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
translations.ylt: Then, therefore, did Pilate take Jesus and scourge him,
translations.web: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

translations.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
translations.ylt: and the soldiers having plaited a crown of thorns, did place it on his head, and a purple garment they put around him,
translations.web: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

translations.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
translations.ylt: and said, `Hail! the king of the Jews;' and they were giving him slaps.
translations.web: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

translations.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, again went forth without, and saith to them, `Lo, I do bring him to you without, that ye may know that in him I find no fault;'
translations.web: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

translations.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, came forth without, bearing the thorny crown and the purple garment; and he saith to them, `Lo, the man!'
translations.web: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

translations.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
translations.ylt: When, therefore, the chief priests and the officers did see him, they cried out, saying, `Crucify, crucify;' Pilate saith to them, `Take ye him--ye, and crucify; for I find no fault in him;'
translations.web: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

translations.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
translations.ylt: the Jews answered him, `We have a law, and according to our law he ought to die, for he made himself Son of God.'
translations.web: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

translations.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
translations.ylt: When, therefore, Pilate heard this word, he was the more afraid,
translations.web: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

translations.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
translations.ylt: and entered again to the praetorium, and saith to Jesus, `Whence art thou?' and Jesus gave him no answer.
translations.web: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

translations.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, saith to him, `To me dost thou not speak? hast thou not known that I have authority to crucify thee, and I have authority to release thee?'
translations.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
translations.ylt: Jesus answered, `Thou wouldest have no authority against me, if it were not having been given thee from above; because of this, he who is delivering me up to thee hath greater sin.'
translations.web: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

translations.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.
translations.ylt: From this time was Pilate seeking to release him, and the Jews were crying out, saying, `If this one thou mayest release, thou art not a friend of Caesar; every one making himself a king, doth speak against Caesar.'
translations.web: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

translations.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
translations.ylt: Pilate, therefore, having heard this word, brought Jesus without--and he sat down upon the tribunal--to a place called, `Pavement,' and in Hebrew, Gabbatha;
translations.web: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

translations.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
translations.ylt: and it was the preparation of the passover, and as it were the sixth hour, and he saith to the Jews, `Lo, your king!'
translations.web: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

translations.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.
translations.ylt: and they cried out, `Take away, take away, crucify him;' Pilate saith to them, `Your king shall I crucify?' the chief priests answered, `We have no king except Caesar.'
translations.web: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

translations.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
translations.ylt: Then, therefore, he delivered him up to them, that he may be crucified, and they took Jesus and led him away,
translations.web: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

translations.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
translations.ylt: and bearing his cross, he went forth to the place called Place of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew Golgotha;
translations.web: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

translations.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
translations.ylt: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on this side, and on that side, and Jesus in the midst.
translations.web: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

translations.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
translations.ylt: And Pilate also wrote a title, and put it on the cross, and it was written, `Jesus the Nazarene, the king of the Jews;'
translations.web: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

translations.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
translations.ylt: this title, therefore, read many of the Jews, because the place was nigh to the city where Jesus was crucified, and it was having been written in Hebrew, in Greek, in Roman.
translations.web: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

translations.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
translations.ylt: The chief priests of the Jews said, therefore, to Pilate, `Write not--The king of the Jews, but that one said, I am king of the Jews;'
translations.web: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

translations.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
translations.ylt: Pilate answered, `What I have written, I have written.'
translations.web: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

translations.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
translations.ylt: The soldiers, therefore, when they did crucify Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to each soldier a part, also the coat, and the coat was seamless, from the top woven throughout,
translations.web: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

translations.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
translations.ylt: they said, therefore, to one another, `We may not rend it, but cast a lot for it, whose it shall be;' that the Writing might be fulfilled, that is saying, `They divided my garments to themselves, and upon my raiment they did cast a lot;' the soldiers, therefore, indeed, did these things.
translations.web: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

translations.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
translations.ylt: And there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary of Cleopas, and Mary the Magdalene;
translations.web: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, having seen his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he was loving, he saith to his mother, `Woman, lo, thy son;'
translations.web: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

translations.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
translations.ylt: afterward he saith to the disciple, `Lo, thy mother;' and from that hour the disciple took her to his own home.
translations.web: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

translations.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
translations.ylt: After this, Jesus knowing that all things now have been finished, that the Writing may be fulfilled, saith, `I thirst;'
translations.web: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

translations.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
translations.ylt: a vessel, therefore, was placed full of vinegar, and they having filled a sponge with vinegar, and having put it around a hyssop stalk, did put it to his mouth;
translations.web: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
translations.ylt: when, therefore, Jesus received the vinegar, he said, `It hath been finished;' and having bowed the head, gave up the spirit.
translations.web: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

translations.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
translations.ylt: The Jews, therefore, that the bodies might not remain on the cross on the sabbath, since it was the preparation, (for that sabbath day was a great one,) asked of Pilate that their legs may be broken, and they taken away.
translations.web: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

translations.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
translations.ylt: The soldiers, therefore, came, and of the first indeed they did break the legs, and of the other who was crucified with him,
translations.web: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

translations.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
translations.ylt: and having come to Jesus, when they saw him already having been dead, they did not break his legs;
translations.web: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

translations.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
translations.ylt: but one of the soldiers with a spear did pierce his side, and immediately there came forth blood and water;
translations.web: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

translations.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
translations.ylt: and he who hath seen hath testified, and his testimony is true, and that one hath known that true things he speaketh, that ye also may believe.
translations.web: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

translations.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
translations.ylt: For these things came to pass, that the Writing may be fulfilled, `A bone of him shall not be broken;'
translations.web: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

translations.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
translations.ylt: and again another Writing saith, `They shall look to him whom they did pierce.'
translations.web: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

translations.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
translations.ylt: And after these things did Joseph of Arimathea--being a disciple of Jesus, but concealed, through the fear of the Jews--ask of Pilate, that he may take away the body of Jesus, and Pilate gave leave; he came, therefore, and took away the body of Jesus,
translations.web: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

translations.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
translations.ylt: and Nicodemus also came--who came unto Jesus by night at the first--bearing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, as it were, a hundred pounds.
translations.web: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

translations.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
translations.ylt: They took, therefore, the body of Jesus, and bound it with linen clothes with the spices, according as it was the custom of the Jews to prepare for burial;
translations.web: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

translations.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
translations.ylt: and there was in the place where he was crucified a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one was yet laid;
translations.web: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

translations.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
translations.ylt: there, therefore, because of the preparation of the Jews, because the tomb was nigh, they laid Jesus.
translations.web: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

translations.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: And on the first of the sabbaths, Mary the Magdalene doth come early (there being yet darkness) to the tomb, and she seeth the stone having been taken away out of the tomb,
translations.web: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

translations.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
translations.ylt: she runneth, therefore, and cometh unto Simon Peter, and unto the other disciple whom Jesus was loving, and saith to them, `They took away the Lord out of the tomb, and we have not known where they laid him.'
translations.web: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

translations.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: Peter, therefore, went forth, and the other disciple, and they were coming to the tomb,
translations.web: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

translations.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: and the two were running together, and the other disciple did run forward more quickly than Peter, and came first to the tomb,
translations.web: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

translations.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
translations.ylt: and having stooped down, seeth the linen clothes lying, yet, indeed, he entered not.
translations.web: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

translations.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
translations.ylt: Simon Peter, therefore, cometh, following him, and he entered into the tomb, and beholdeth the linen clothes lying,
translations.web: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

translations.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
translations.ylt: and the napkin that was upon his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but apart, having been folded up, in one place;
translations.web: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

translations.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
translations.ylt: then, therefore, entered also the other disciple who came first unto the tomb, and he saw, and did believe;
translations.web: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

translations.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
translations.ylt: for not yet did they know the Writing, that it behoveth him out of the dead to rise again.
translations.web: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

translations.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
translations.ylt: The disciples therefore went away again unto their own friends,
translations.web: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

translations.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
translations.ylt: and Mary was standing near the tomb, weeping without; as she was weeping, then, she stooped down to the tomb, and beholdeth two messengers in white, sitting,
translations.web: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

translations.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
translations.ylt: one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had been laid.
translations.web: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
