translations.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
translations.ylt: And they say to her, `Woman, why dost thou weep?' she saith to them, `Because they took away my Lord, and I have not known where they laid him;'
translations.web: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

translations.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
translations.ylt: and these things having said, she turned backward, and seeth Jesus standing, and she had not known that it is Jesus.
translations.web: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Woman, why dost thou weep? whom dost thou seek;' she, supposing that he is the gardener, saith to him, `Sir, if thou didst carry him away, tell me where thou didst lay him, and I will take him away;'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Mary!' having turned, she saith to him, `Rabbouni;' that is to say, `Teacher.'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to her, `Be not touching me, for I have not yet ascended unto my Father; and be going on to my brethren, and say to them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father, and to my God, and to your God.'
translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

translations.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
translations.ylt: Mary the Magdalene cometh, telling to the disciples that she hath seen the Lord, and that these things he said to her.
translations.web: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

translations.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
translations.ylt: It being, therefore, evening, on that day, the first of the sabbaths, and the doors having been shut where the disciples were assembled, through fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith to them, `Peace to you;'
translations.web: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

translations.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
translations.ylt: and this having said, he shewed them his hands and side; the disciples, therefore, rejoiced, having seen the Lord.
translations.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

translations.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, said to them again, `Peace to you; according as the Father hath sent me, I also send you;'
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

translations.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
translations.ylt: and this having said, he breathed on them, and saith to them, `Receive the Holy Spirit;
translations.web: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

translations.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
translations.ylt: if of any ye may loose the sins, they are loosed to them; if of any ye may retain, they have been retained.'
translations.web: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

translations.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
translations.ylt: And Thomas, one of the twelve, who is called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came;
translations.web: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

translations.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
translations.ylt: the other disciples, therefore, said to him, `We have seen the Lord;' and he said to them, `If I may not see in his hands the mark of the nails, and may put my finger to the mark of the nails, and may put my hand to his side, I will not believe.'
translations.web: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

translations.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
translations.ylt: And after eight days, again were his disciples within, and Thomas with them; Jesus cometh, the doors having been shut, and he stood in the midst, and said, `Peace to you!'
translations.web: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

translations.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
translations.ylt: then he saith to Thomas, `Bring thy finger hither, and see my hands, and bring thy hand, and put it to my side, and become not unbelieving, but believing.'
translations.web: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

translations.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
translations.ylt: And Thomas answered and said to him, `My Lord and my God;'
translations.web: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `Because thou hast seen me, Thomas, thou hast believed; happy those not having seen, and having believed.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

translations.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
translations.ylt: Many indeed, therefore, other signs also did Jesus before his disciples, that are not written in this book;
translations.web: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

translations.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
translations.ylt: and these have been written that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing ye may have life in his name.'
translations.web: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

translations.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
translations.ylt: After these things did Jesus manifest himself again to the disciples on the sea of Tiberias, and he did manifest himself thus:
translations.web: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

translations.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
translations.ylt: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas who is called Didymus, and Nathanael from Cana of Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples.
translations.web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

translations.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter saith to them, `I go away to fish;' they say to him, `We go--we also--with thee;' they went forth and entered into the boat immediately, and on that night they caught nothing.
translations.web: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

translations.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
translations.ylt: And morning being now come, Jesus stood at the shore, yet indeed the disciples did not know that it is Jesus;
translations.web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

translations.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, saith to them, `Lads, have ye any meat?'
translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
translations.ylt: they answered him, `No;' and he said to them, `Cast the net at the right side of the boat, and ye shall find;' they cast, therefore, and no longer were they able to draw it, from the multitude of the fishes.
translations.web: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

translations.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
translations.ylt: That disciple, therefore, whom Jesus was loving saith to Peter, `The Lord it is!' Simon Peter, therefore, having heard that it is the Lord, did gird on the outer coat, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea;
translations.web: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

translations.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
translations.ylt: and the other disciples came by the little boat, for they were not far from the land, but as it were about two hundred cubits off, dragging the net of the fishes;
translations.web: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

translations.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
translations.ylt: when, therefore, they came to the land, they behold a fire of coals lying, and a fish lying on it, and bread.
translations.web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to them, `Bring ye from the fishes that ye caught now;'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

translations.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
translations.ylt: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net up on the land, full of great fishes, an hundred fifty and three, and though they were so many, the net was not rent.
translations.web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to them, `Come ye, dine;' and none of the disciples was venturing to inquire of him, `Who art thou?' knowing that it is the Lord;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

translations.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
translations.ylt: Jesus, therefore, doth come and take the bread and give to them, and the fish in like manner;
translations.web: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

translations.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
translations.ylt: this is now a third time Jesus was manifested to his disciples, having been raised from the dead.
translations.web: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

translations.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
translations.ylt: When, therefore, they dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, `Simon, son of Jonas, dost thou love me more than these?' he saith to him, `Yes, Lord; thou hast known that I dearly love thee;' he saith to him, `Feed my lambs.'
translations.web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

translations.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
translations.ylt: He saith to him again, a second time, `Simon, son of Jonas, dost thou love me?' he saith to him, `Yes, Lord; thou hast known that I dearly love thee;' he saith to him, `Tend my sheep.'
translations.web: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

translations.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
translations.ylt: He saith to him the third time, `Simon, son of Jonas, dost thou dearly love me?' Peter was grieved that he said to him the third time, `Dost thou dearly love me?' and he said to him, `Lord, thou hast known all things; thou dost know that I dearly love thee.' Jesus saith to him, `Feed my sheep;
translations.web: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
translations.ylt: verily, verily, I say to thee, When thou wast younger, thou wast girding thyself and wast walking whither thou didst will, but when thou mayest be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another will gird thee, and shall carry thee whither thou dost not will;'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

translations.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
translations.ylt: and this he said, signifying by what death he shall glorify God; and having said this, he saith to him, `Be following me.'
translations.web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
translations.ylt: And Peter having turned about doth see the disciple whom Jesus was loving following, (who also reclined in the supper on his breast, and said, `Sir, who is he who is delivering thee up?')
translations.web: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

translations.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
translations.ylt: Peter having seen this one, saith to Jesus, `Lord, and what of this one?'
translations.web: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
translations.ylt: Jesus saith to him, `If him I will to remain till I come, what--to thee? be thou following me.' This word, therefore, went forth to the brethren that that disciple doth not die,
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

translations.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
translations.ylt: yet Jesus did not say to him, that he doth not die, but, `If him I will to remain till I come, what--to thee?'
translations.web: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

translations.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
translations.ylt: this is the disciple who is testifying concerning these things, and he wrote these things, and we have known that his testimony is true.
translations.web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

translations.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
translations.ylt: And there are also many other things--as many as Jesus did--which, if they may be written one by one, not even the world itself I think to have place for the books written. Amen.
translations.web: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
